raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

With `--monokernel`, Muse Spark Open MXFP4 on 8x MI355X (TP8 + expert parallelism, 7-token DSpark draft) runs
decoder layers 1-60 of every verify step of 1-16 requests as persistent FlyDSL launches. One launch, or three, cover
the work from a layer's attention output to the next layer's q, o-gate and KV insert. All other steps and layers 0 and
61 run the stock path. The flag is off by default.

## Claims

- AgentX (agentic-coding traces, DSpark at synthetic acceptance length 4.05, all requests, full mode), this PR's head
  with `--monokernel` vs the faster stock recipe on its base (main 3d81a51): interactivity (1000 / p90 ITL) / total
  tok/s/GPU of 413.8 / 2974 vs 263.1 / 2325 at c = 1 (+57 % / +28 %), 314.1 / 3056 vs 232.7 / 2368 at c = 2
  (+35 % / +29 %), 295.2 / 4430 vs 217.3 / 3585 at c = 4 (+36 % / +24 %) and 208.4 / 7384 vs 143.3 / 6126 at c = 8
  (+45 % / +21 %).
- Accuracy contract (GPQA-Diamond, AIME25, RULER NIAH; method of #60397), `--monokernel` vs stock: GPQA-Diamond
  88.7 vs 88.5 (delta +0.1 ± 0.5; boxed-letter prompt -0.7 ± 0.6), AIME25 98.6 vs 98.3 (+0.3 ± 0.4), RULER NIAH 348 vs 346 of 360.
- Accuracy and DSpark acceptance, real acceptance, stock (main 3d81a51) and `--monokernel` (c0f424a) with the same
  server flags: GSM8K (full set, 5-shot) 0.9651-0.9735 with `--monokernel` and 0.9666-0.9742 stock at c = 1-16, mean
  acceptance length 4.512 vs 4.431. Long-context needle retrieval at 33k-529k tokens: 192/192 in both arms, mean
  acceptance length 3.638 vs 3.600.
- Opt-in only. If the deployment is not supported, vLLM refuses it at startup with every reason. Steps that the
  kernels do not cover run stock. Nothing changes without `--monokernel`.

## Validation

All runs: c0f424a (`--monokernel`) and its base, main 3d81a51 (stock), on the vLLM ROCm nightly image 00b6c4c (AITER
0.1.26) with the Python files of each commit, 8x MI355X. After these runs, the head e2ed1f0 removes redundant code and
adds two startup refusals (sleep mode, weight transfer): all 30 builds compile to identical `.text`, and the 26
monokernel code objects that its server loads have the same sha1 as on c0f424a. On 49485cc (the head without the two
refusals): GSM8K c = 8 0.9674 with acceptance length 4.495; AgentX fast mode vs c0f424a 328.8 / 2867 vs 330.5 / 2865
at c = 1 and 209.2 / 6135 vs 215.4 / 6151 at c = 8 (fast-mode noise).

### Performance: AgentX

Server: the recipe's Muse Spark Open MXFP4 command on 8x MI355X with the DSpark draft. Changes for the benchmark:
`--max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 16`, `--enable-prefix-caching`, and synthetic acceptance
(`"rejection_sample_method":"synthetic","synthetic_acceptance_length":4.05`). The `--monokernel` server is TEP8.
Stock runs the recipe's two strategies: plain TP8 (with `--max-num-seqs 8`, the recipe's 1M-context TP setting; the
recipe's lowest-latency choice for one request) and TEP8 (the same command as the `--monokernel` arm without
`--monokernel`). Benchmark: `agentx profile --public-dataset semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126 --concurrency C`. This
dataset is agentic-coding traces with an ISL p50 of 159k tokens and a maximum of 397k. Metrics are over all
requests: interactivity = 1000 / p90 ITL (tok/s/user) and total tok/s/GPU.

Full mode (`--benchmark-duration 3600 --warmup-requests-per-lane 10`), one run a point. Each cell: interactivity /
total tok/s/GPU (p90 ITL in ms, requests):

| c | `--monokernel` (TEP8) | stock TP8 | stock TEP8 | `--monokernel` vs the faster stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 413.8 / 2974 (2.42, 291) | 263.1 / 2325 (3.80, 256) | | +57 % / +28 % |
| 2 | 314.1 / 3056 (3.18, 474) | 232.7 / 2368 (4.30, 398) | 223.5 / 2367 (4.47, 398) | +35 % / +29 % |
| 4 | 295.2 / 4430 (3.39, 668) | 217.3 / 3585 (4.60, 580) | 212.5 / 3392 (4.71, 557) | +36 % / +24 % |
| 8 | 208.4 / 7384 (4.80, 1362) | | 143.3 / 6126 (6.98, 1176) | +45 % / +21 % |

Stock TP8 at c = 8 and stock TEP8 at c = 1 were not run (the recipe names TEP8 the faster choice from a few
concurrent requests, and TP8 for one request). This PR does not measure c >= 16.

### Accuracy

Real acceptance (the recipe's block verification), stock and `--monokernel` with the same server flags: TEP8
(`--tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel`) in both arms; the only difference is `--monokernel`. The
acceptance length is the DSpark mean acceptance length from the server's `/metrics` over each run.

GSM8K = InferenceX gsm8k.yaml, full set (1319), 5-shot, prefix caching off (flexible-extract; strict-match differs by
0.0008 at most). Output tok/s = the generated tokens (from `/metrics`) / the wall time of the run:

| c | GSM8K stock | GSM8K mono | acceptance length stock | acceptance length mono | output tok/s stock | output tok/s mono |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.9666 | 0.9666 | 4.533 | 4.570 | 300 | 480 |
| 2 | 0.9719 | 0.9735 | 4.488 | 4.465 | 520 | 662 |
| 4 | 0.9719 | 0.9697 | 4.461 | 4.524 | 862 | 1124 |
| 8 | 0.9712 | 0.9704 | 4.400 | 4.422 | 1329 | 1465 |
| 16 | 0.9742 | 0.9651 | 4.273 | 4.577 | 1973 | 2125 |
| mean | 0.9712 | 0.9691 | 4.431 | 4.512 | | |

The stderr of one GSM8K score is about 0.005; the per-c differences go both ways. Three more runs at c = 16 (on the
head e2ed1f0): stock 0.9682 / 0.9689 / 0.9704, `--monokernel` 0.9727 / 0.9727 / 0.9742.

With the AgentX server flags (prefix caching on), GSM8K at c = 8: stock 0.9682 with acceptance length 4.526,
`--monokernel` 0.9704 with 4.426.

Long context: multi-key needle retrieval. Each prompt hides 8 seven-digit numbers in filler text and asks for one;
the answer is scored by exact match. 12 prompts at each length, each run at c = 1, 2, 4 and 8, prefix caching on:

| context | correct stock | correct mono | acceptance length stock | acceptance length mono |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 33k | 48/48 | 48/48 | 3.525 | 3.648 |
| 132k | 48/48 | 48/48 | 3.649 | 3.607 |
| 264k | 48/48 | 48/48 | 3.620 | 3.672 |
| 529k | 48/48 | 48/48 | 3.623 | 3.627 |

The answers are short (about 360 tokens), so the acceptance length is lower than on GSM8K in both arms.

#### Accuracy contract: GPQA-Diamond, AIME25, RULER NIAH

Method of #60397 / RFC #59665: pass@1, the same build and server flags in both arms (TEP8, DSpark with real
acceptance, prefix caching on, 8 requests in flight); stock = main 3d81a51, `--monokernel` = the head
e2ed1f0. ± is the standard error across questions; delta is mono - stock, paired by question.

| | stock | `--monokernel` | delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| GPQA-Diamond, the GPQA authors' prompt (16 samples a question) | 88.5 ± 1.8 | 88.7 ± 1.8 | +0.1 ± 0.5 |
| GPQA-Diamond, boxed-letter prompt (16 samples a question) | 86.4 ± 1.8 | 85.7 ± 1.8 | -0.7 ± 0.6 |
| AIME25 (32 samples a problem) | 98.3 ± 0.7 | 98.6 ± 0.7 | +0.3 ± 0.4 |
| RULER NIAH (single, multikey 2 and 3 at 32K / 128K / 256K, 40 a cell) | 346/360 | 348/360 | |

- GPQA-Diamond: InferenceX's questions (each in 2 option orders), 8 seeds, `reasoning_effort` xhigh, temperature
  1.0, top-k 64 (the model's generation config), 64K tokens. First row: the zero-shot prompt and answer parser of the
  GPQA authors' repository. Second row: a "put the letter in `\boxed{}`" instruction, graded with InferenceX's
  last-letter rule. With 4 seeds per arm the delta moved from -1.3 (seeds 0-3) to +1.5 (seeds 4-7) on the same prompt,
  so the seed-to-seed spread is larger than the per-question standard error.
- AIME25: lm-eval's `aime25` with the boxed-answer instruction, `reasoning_effort` high, temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95,
  64K tokens, 32 seeds.
- RULER NIAH: lm-eval's RULER tasks, greedy, `reasoning_effort` high, 32K tokens, every needle must be in the answer.
  The misses are the same kinds in both arms (stock 11 / mono 8 with an empty answer, 3 / 4 with a distractor key).

The server logs have 0 errors and 0 peer-wait timeouts in every run.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_MOE_REDUCE_DTYPE=bf16 VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \
       AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN_SHORT_QUERY_3D=1 VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=LBHNC VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=0
vllm serve amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel \
  --reasoning-parser muse --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser muse \
  --dtype bfloat16 --distributed-executor-backend mp --language-model-only \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' \
  --disable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 16 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Inferact/Muse-Spark-Open-DSpark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block","enable_adaptive_verification":false,"attention_backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA"}' \
  --monokernel        # stock TEP8: the same command without --monokernel; stock TP8: also without
                      # --enable-expert-parallel, and --max-num-seqs 8

# GSM8K: InferenceX gsm8k.yaml (5-shot, full set), lm-eval chat completions, temperature 0, concurrency C (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
lm_eval --model local-chat-completions --apply_chat_template --tasks gsm8k.yaml \
  --model_args model=amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=C,tokenized_requests=False,max_length=1048576 \
  --gen_kwargs max_tokens=16384,temperature=0,top_p=1
```

For AgentX: add `--enable-prefix-caching` and set `"rejection_sample_method":"synthetic","synthetic_acceptance_length":4.05`.
</details>

## Details

### Hook point

- `MuseSpark1xForCausalLM.process_weights_after_loading` calls `maybe_attach_mono`. This runs after the per-layer quant
  finalize, so the experts are already in their shuffled kernel layout. The call is collective over the TP group.
  `MuseSpark1xModel.mono` is `None` without `--monokernel`.
- `MuseSpark1xModel.forward`: if `mono.try_forward(...)` returns the residual stream, the stock layer loop does not
  run. Otherwise the stock loop runs as before.
- `MuseSpark1xAttention.forward` ends in a new `back` (o-norm, o-gate, o_proj), and `MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer.forward`
  in a new `after_attention`. The monokernel runs layer 1 up to the attention with the stock functions and calls these
  two at the seams. The stock path calls the same code in the same order.
- `compute_logits` and `compute_logits_local` start an asynchronous read of the kernels' health words (every 64
  steps, outside graph capture). A peer-rank wait that timed out raises there, instead of a hang.
- The model runner, the scheduler and the attention backends are not changed.

### Eligibility

- At startup (default deny; one `ValueError` with every reason, agreed over the TP CPU group): gfx950 with 256 CUs,
  the checkpoint's text config, TP8 + `--enable-expert-parallel` (linear placement, no EPLB), no PP / DP / DCP / PCP,
  DSpark with 7 draft tokens, no LoRA, sleep mode or weight transfer, no KV connector or offloading, bf16 model and KV
  cache, Quark OCP-MXFP4 W4A4 experts on AITER (shuffled weights and scales), the fused QK-norm / RoPE / KV insert,
  `ROCM_AITER_FA`.
- Every step, from rank-invariant data only (the batch shape and the attention metadata counts, because all ranks
  must take the same path). The step must be a uniform verify step of 1-16 requests x 8 tokens, in FULL CUDA graph
  or eager mode, with dense bf16 LBHNC KV caches (block size 16). All other steps run stock.

### Buckets

| rows (requests) | build | launches a layer |
|---|---|---|
| 8 (1), 16 (2) | K3, S = 8 / 16 | 1 |
| 24-32 (3-4) | HA + HM + HB, S = 32 | 3 |
| 40-128 (5-16) | HA + HM + HB, S = 64 / 96 / 128 (rows padded up; `nrows` = real rows) | 3 |

`--max-num-seqs` selects the builds that the server compiles. Weights are views of vLLM's parameters. The kernels
write KV into vLLM's pages through `slot_mapping` (padding slots are skipped). The peer buffers are plain `cudaMalloc`
memory, opened over IPC on the TP CPU group. All launch arguments are fixed pointers, so vLLM's FULL CUDA graphs
capture the launches.

### Fused verify attention (8, 16 and 32 rows)

From layer 2 on, layer i's verify attention runs at the head of K3_i / HA_i, for both the sliding-window and the full
layers. It is split over all 256 CTAs by (request, KV head, key range) and merged before o_proj. It reads the layer's
bf16 KV cache through its KV cache group's `block_table` / `seq_lens`, the impl's softmax scale, and the window
(2047, 0). Only blocks inside the window are read. The descriptor tables hold pointers and counts only. They are
keyed by their contents and written once, so captured graphs read fixed tables. If `max_model_len` is above the 1M
keys that the builds stage block ids for, vLLM's op runs. Builds of 40 rows and more keep vLLM's op.

### Numerics: a16w4, opt-in behind `--monokernel`

The kernels keep the MoE activations in bf16 (MXFP4 weights x bf16 activations). The stock path is W4A4: it
quantizes the expert inputs and the SwiGLU output to MXFP4. Thus `--monokernel` output is close to the stock output,
but not bit-identical. Prefill runs stock (W4A4). Other differences are the reduction order (fixed rank order in fp32)
and the bf16 norm multipliers. The flag help, the module README and the recipe describe this.

### Known issues

- With the DFlash2 draft (not the recipe's draft), `--monokernel` lowers the real acceptance length: AgentX c = 4
  4.83 -> 3.52. The aux-hidden-state bookkeeping is the same as in the stock loop: the new tests compare the aux
  states for the DSpark, DFlash2 and seam target layers. The cause is open (per-rank draft divergence, or a draft
  that is more sensitive to the a16w4 numerics). The recipe's DSpark draft is not affected on AgentX (2.83 vs 2.87).
- The FlyDSL cleanup keeps some unused launch arguments (the timeline and EPLB-replica pointers) and LDS slots. With
  them, every build compiles to the same code objects as the validated kernels: identical `.text` for all 30 server
  builds.
- CI cannot run the kernels: they need 8x MI355X and the checkpoint's shapes. The CI test runs the host side on one
  MI355X (below). The kernel paths were validated with the serving runs above.

### Vendored kernels

`vllm/models/muse_spark/amd/mono/kernels/` (about 6.7k lines) holds AMD's Muse Spark FlyDSL monokernel sources,
reduced to the builds that vLLM launches. They carry their MIT license header after vLLM's SPDX lines (as in
`rocm_block32_gemm.py`). They import FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers only when the monokernel attaches. The host code
(mono/ without kernels/, model.py and two small core edits) is about 1.3k lines.

### Test plan

```bash
pytest -v -s tests/models/test_muse_spark_rocm_mono.py tests/models/test_muse_spark_logits_local.py \
  tests/models/test_muse_spark_rocm_loading.py
pre-commit run --files $(git diff --name-only origin/main)
```

- On the head e2ed1f0 (main 3d81a51): 1x MI355X: 47 passed (39 s), on the vLLM ROCm nightly image 00b6c4c with the
  Python files of this branch. Pre-commit: all hooks pass.
- `test_muse_spark_rocm_mono.py` builds a tiny real MuseSpark1x model (Quark MXFP4 experts, `ROCM_AITER_FA`, LBHNC bf16
  KV cache). It loads the model through the dummy loader + `load_weights` + `process_weights_after_loading`, and runs
  it with real attention metadata builders and bound KV caches.
  - Guards: refused before the weight finalize, accepted after it. Config and deployment guards use real vLLM
    configs.
  - Weight views alias vLLM's parameters.
  - Step tests (7 shapes x 3 aux-layer sets: the DSpark and DFlash2 drafts' layers and the stock / mono seams): the
    FlyDSL launches build only for the checkpoint's TEP8 shapes. The test runs each launch as the stock layer pieces
    that it replaces, on the device memory at the pointers that the host passes. Hidden states and the KV caches of
    all layers are bit-exact vs the stock loop. Aux hidden states match at fp32 rounding. Prefill, mixed, short-query,
    too-wide and PIECEWISE steps run stock.
  - Mutants fail these tests: aux shifted by one layer, dropped aux gather, wrong q buffer for the fused attention,
    KV written to the wrong layer, dropped stock layer-1 aux.
- The test is in the `Basic Models (Other)` step and its MI355 mirror (`models_basic.yaml`).

### Follow-ups

- Move to the RFC #60904 layout (`vllm/models/muse_spark/amd/specialized_decode/`, tests under
  `tests/models/muse_spark/`) in a separate PR.
- A TP8 numerics test on 8x MI355X: each launch vs vLLM's layer on random full-size weights, as
  `test_dsv41_mono_numerics.py` does.
- Fused attention for the 40-128-row builds (c >= 5).
- Remove the unused launch arguments and LDS slots (this changes the code objects, so it needs a new validation).
- The DFlash2 acceptance drop (known issues).

### AI assistance

This PR was developed with AI assistance (Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5). The submitter reviewed every changed line
and ran the tests and benchmarks listed above.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).

nodes.body: deployment_refusals does not refuse sleep mode or weight transfer. The attach keeps bf16 copies of five norm multipliers per layer (:199-204) plus the epoch and health words in tensors that are neither parameters nor buffers, allocated in the cumem weights pool. With the recipe's --monokernel command plus --enable-sleep-mode, the documented sleep(level=2), wake_up, reload_weights flow restores only named buffers, and ROCm wakes the rest of the pool zeroed (vllm/device_allocator/cumem.py:361-363). Reload never calls the model-level process_weights_after_loading, so refresh_weights (mono/init.py:96-98) never runs. Verify steps of 1-16 requests then run layers 1-60 with zero norm multipliers and emit wrong tokens. Weight-transfer refits skip the refresh the same way. Refuse enable_sleep_mode and weight_transfer_config, as vllm/models/minimax_m3/amd/specialized_decode/runtime/spec.py:63-66 does.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MuseSpark1x decode monokernel: layers 1-60 of a verify step as FlyDSL launches.
+
+Per eligible step (1-16 requests x 8 verify tokens, TP8 with expert
+parallelism; see README.md):
+
+- layer 0: stock.
+- layer 1: stock attention input and attention front (QKV, QK-norm, RoPE, KV
+  insert), then vLLM's attention op.
+- layers 1-60: from layer i's attention output to layer i+1's q, o-gate and
+  KV insert: o-norm/gate, o_proj, the attention boundary, the MoE with its EP
+  all-reduce, the FFN boundary, layer i+1's QKV+O-gate GEMV, QK-norm and RoPE.
+  8 / 16 rows: one K3 launch; 24-128 rows: HA, HM (the experts) and HB.
+  vLLM's attention op on that q is layer i+1's attention.
+- layer 61: vLLM's attention op, then the stock tail.
+- fused attention (8, 16 and 24-32 rows): layer i's attention (i > 1) runs at
+  the head of K3_i / HA_i instead of vLLM's op,
+  from the previous launch's q and the layer's KV cache, block table and
+  seq_lens (``kernels/attn_frag.py``).
+
+Every rank must take the same path (the kernel waits on its peers), so the
+decision uses only rank-invariant data: the static deployment checked at
+attach, the batch shape and the attention metadata counts.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import get_attention_context
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.layers import (
+    MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection,
+    MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale,
+    norm_then_gated_residual,
+)
+
+from ..muse_moe_runner import MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE
+from .peer import PeerBuffer
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+FIRST_LAYER = 1
+LAST_LAYER = 60
+ROWS_PER_REQUEST = 8
+K3_ROWS = (8, 16)
+K5_ROWS = (32, 64, 96, 128)
+WORLD_SIZE = 8
+NUM_CUS = 256
+KV_BLOCK_SIZE = 16
+HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL = 64
+# Attention types whose verify attention runs inside the launch, per build.
+# Other builds and layer 1 run vLLM's attention op.
+FUSED_ATTENTION = {8: ("swa", "full"), 16: ("swa", "full"), 32: ("swa", "full")}
+SLIDING_WINDOW = (2047, 0)
+
+# The model shape the K3 build is specialized for.
+KERNEL_CONFIG: dict[str, float] = {
+    "hidden_size": 8192,
+    "moe_hidden_size": 4096,
+    "moe_intermediate_size": 4096,
+    "num_local_experts": 256,
+    "num_experts_per_tok": 8,
+    "head_dim": 64,
+    "num_attention_heads": 128,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 16,
+    "num_hidden_layers": 62,
+    "routed_scaling_factor": 1.0,
+    "rms_norm_eps": 1e-5,
+    "post_norm_eps": 1e-8,
+    "residual_gate_temperature": 0.3,
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MonoDims:
+    """Per-rank tensor sizes of a TP = EP rank."""
+
+    world_size: int
+    hidden_size: int
+    pooled_size: int
+    intermediate_size: int
+    num_experts: int
+    num_heads: int
+    num_kv_heads: int
+    head_dim: int
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_config(cls, config: Any, world_size: int) -> "MonoDims":
+        return cls(
+            world_size=world_size,
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            pooled_size=config.moe_hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            num_experts=config.num_local_experts,
+            num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=config.num_key_value_heads,
+            head_dim=config.head_dim,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def local_experts(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_experts // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def local_kv_heads(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_kv_heads // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def q_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_heads // self.world_size * self.head_dim
+
+    @property
+    def kv_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.local_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+
+    @property
+    def qkvg_rows(self) -> int:
+        return 2 * self.q_rows + 2 * self.kv_rows
+
+    def expert_shapes(self) -> dict[str, tuple[int, ...]]:
+        """MXFP4 expert tensors of the local experts, as uint8."""
+        e, h, i = self.local_experts, self.pooled_size, self.intermediate_size
+        return {
+            "w13_weight": (e, 2 * i, h // 2),
+            "w13_weight_scale": (e, 2 * i, h // 32),
+            "w2_weight": (e, h, i // 2),
+            "w2_weight_scale": (e, h, i // 32),
+        }
+
+
+def bucket_of(rows: int) -> int | None:
+    """The kernel build that serves ``rows`` (padded up); None = stock."""
+    if rows <= 0 or rows % ROWS_PER_REQUEST:
+        return None
+    if rows in K3_ROWS:
+        return rows
+    return next((s for s in K5_ROWS if rows <= s), None)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LayerWeights:
+    """Views of vLLM's parameters (and small norm copies) for layer i's launches."""
+
+    w_o: torch.Tensor
+    alpha_a: torch.Tensor
+    beta_a: torch.Tensor
+    w_pffn: torch.Tensor
+    w_r: torch.Tensor
+    bias: torch.Tensor
+    w_pre: torch.Tensor
+    w_pren: torch.Tensor
+    w13: torch.Tensor
+    w13s: torch.Tensor
+    w2: torch.Tensor
+    w2s: torch.Tensor
+    w_post: torch.Tensor
+    w_pp: torch.Tensor
+    w_pff: torch.Tensor
+    alpha: torch.Tensor
+    beta: torch.Tensor
+    w_in: torch.Tensor
+    w_qkvg: torch.Tensor
+    next_rope: bool
+
+    def _ptrs(self, *names: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return tuple(getattr(self, n).data_ptr() for n in names)
+
+    def ha_pointers(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """Attention boundary, router and pre-expert projection (HA, K3)."""
+        return self._ptrs(
+            "w_o", "alpha_a", "beta_a", "w_pffn", "w_r", "bias", "w_pre", "w_pren"
+        )
+
+    def hm_pointers(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """The local experts (HM, K3)."""
+        return self._ptrs("w13", "w13s", "w2", "w2s", "w_post")
+
+    def hb_pointers(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """Post-expert projection, FFN boundary and the next QKV (HB, K3)."""
+        return self._ptrs("w_pp", "w_pff", "alpha", "beta", "w_in", "w_qkvg")
+
+    def k3_pointers(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return self.ha_pointers() + self.hm_pointers() + self.hb_pointers()
+
+    def expert_replica_pointers(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """The EPLB replica arguments; without replicas, the own experts."""
+        return self._ptrs("w13", "w13s", "w2", "w2s", "w13")
+
+
+def effective_norm_weight(norm: nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The bf16 multiplier the kernel applies: ``weight (+ gain_center)``."""
+    weight = norm.weight.detach().float()
+    if norm.zero_centered_gamma:
+        weight = weight + norm.gain_center
+    return weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+
+
+def _routed_experts(layer: nn.Module) -> nn.Module | None:
+    experts = getattr(layer.feed_forward, "experts", None)
+    return getattr(experts, "routed_experts", None)
+
+
+def _rows(t: torch.Tensor, rank: int, n: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return t.detach()[rank * n : (rank + 1) * n]
+
+
+def collect_layer_weights(
+    layers: Sequence[nn.Module], i: int, rank: int, dims: MonoDims
+) -> LayerWeights:
+    """Layer i's kernel weights from decoder layers ``i`` and ``i + 1``; no copy."""
+    layer, nxt = layers[i], layers[i + 1]
+    moe = layer.feed_forward
+    experts = _routed_experts(layer)
+    assert experts is not None
+    w = dims.world_size
+    return LayerWeights(
+        w_o=layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight.detach(),
+        alpha_a=layer.add_attn.alpha,
+        beta_a=layer.add_attn.beta,
+        w_pffn=effective_norm_weight(layer.pre_ffn_norm),
+        w_r=_rows(moe.router.weight, rank, dims.num_experts // w),
+        bias=moe.expert_bias,
+        w_pre=_rows(moe.pooler.weight, rank, dims.pooled_size // w),
+        w_pren=effective_norm_weight(moe.pre_expert_norm),
+        w13=experts.w13_weight.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w13s=experts.w13_weight_scale.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w2=experts.w2_weight.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w2s=experts.w2_weight_scale.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w_post=effective_norm_weight(moe.post_expert_norm),
+        w_pp=_rows(moe.unpooler.weight, rank, dims.hidden_size // w),
+        w_pff=effective_norm_weight(layer.post_ffn_norm),
+        alpha=layer.add_ffn.alpha,
+        beta=layer.add_ffn.beta,
+        w_in=effective_norm_weight(nxt.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm),
+        w_qkvg=nxt.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight.detach(),
+        next_rope=nxt.self_attn.rotary_emb is not None,
+    )
+
+
+def config_refusals(config: Any) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for name, want in KERNEL_CONFIG.items():
+        got = getattr(config, name, None)
+        if not isinstance(got, (int, float)) or abs(got - want) > 1e-12 * max(
+            1.0, abs(want)
+        ):
+            reasons.append(f"config.{name}={got} (kernel: {want})")
+    return reasons
+
+

detail.body:
## Overview

With `--monokernel`, Muse Spark Open MXFP4 on 8x MI355X (TP8 + expert parallelism, 7-token DSpark draft) runs
decoder layers 1-60 of every verify step of 1-16 requests as persistent FlyDSL launches. One launch, or three, cover
the work from a layer's attention output to the next layer's q, o-gate and KV insert. All other steps and layers 0 and
61 run the stock path. The flag is off by default.

## Claims

- AgentX (agentic-coding traces, DSpark at synthetic acceptance length 4.05, all requests, full mode), this PR's head
  with `--monokernel` vs the faster stock recipe on its base (main 3d81a51): interactivity (1000 / p90 ITL) / total
  tok/s/GPU of 413.8 / 2974 vs 263.1 / 2325 at c = 1 (+57 % / +28 %), 314.1 / 3056 vs 232.7 / 2368 at c = 2
  (+35 % / +29 %), 295.2 / 4430 vs 217.3 / 3585 at c = 4 (+36 % / +24 %) and 208.4 / 7384 vs 143.3 / 6126 at c = 8
  (+45 % / +21 %).
- Accuracy contract (GPQA-Diamond, AIME25, RULER NIAH; method of #60397), `--monokernel` vs stock: GPQA-Diamond
  88.7 vs 88.5 (delta +0.1 ± 0.5; boxed-letter prompt -0.7 ± 0.6), AIME25 98.6 vs 98.3 (+0.3 ± 0.4), RULER NIAH 348 vs 346 of 360.
- Accuracy and DSpark acceptance, real acceptance, stock (main 3d81a51) and `--monokernel` (c0f424a) with the same
  server flags: GSM8K (full set, 5-shot) 0.9651-0.9735 with `--monokernel` and 0.9666-0.9742 stock at c = 1-16, mean
  acceptance length 4.512 vs 4.431. Long-context needle retrieval at 33k-529k tokens: 192/192 in both arms, mean
  acceptance length 3.638 vs 3.600.
- Opt-in only. If the deployment is not supported, vLLM refuses it at startup with every reason. Steps that the
  kernels do not cover run stock. Nothing changes without `--monokernel`.

## Validation

All runs: c0f424a (`--monokernel`) and its base, main 3d81a51 (stock), on the vLLM ROCm nightly image 00b6c4c (AITER
0.1.26) with the Python files of each commit, 8x MI355X. After these runs, the head e2ed1f0 removes redundant code and
adds two startup refusals (sleep mode, weight transfer): all 30 builds compile to identical `.text`, and the 26
monokernel code objects that its server loads have the same sha1 as on c0f424a. On 49485cc (the head without the two
refusals): GSM8K c = 8 0.9674 with acceptance length 4.495; AgentX fast mode vs c0f424a 328.8 / 2867 vs 330.5 / 2865
at c = 1 and 209.2 / 6135 vs 215.4 / 6151 at c = 8 (fast-mode noise).

### Performance: AgentX

Server: the recipe's Muse Spark Open MXFP4 command on 8x MI355X with the DSpark draft. Changes for the benchmark:
`--max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 16`, `--enable-prefix-caching`, and synthetic acceptance
(`"rejection_sample_method":"synthetic","synthetic_acceptance_length":4.05`). The `--monokernel` server is TEP8.
Stock runs the recipe's two strategies: plain TP8 (with `--max-num-seqs 8`, the recipe's 1M-context TP setting; the
recipe's lowest-latency choice for one request) and TEP8 (the same command as the `--monokernel` arm without
`--monokernel`). Benchmark: `agentx profile --public-dataset semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126 --concurrency C`. This
dataset is agentic-coding traces with an ISL p50 of 159k tokens and a maximum of 397k. Metrics are over all
requests: interactivity = 1000 / p90 ITL (tok/s/user) and total tok/s/GPU.

Full mode (`--benchmark-duration 3600 --warmup-requests-per-lane 10`), one run a point. Each cell: interactivity /
total tok/s/GPU (p90 ITL in ms, requests):

| 2 | 314.1 / 3056 (3.18, 474) | 232.7 / 2368 (4.30, 398) | 223.5 / 2367 (4.47, 398) | +35 % / +29 % |
| 4 | 295.2 / 4430 (3.39, 668) | 217.3 / 3585 (4.60, 580) | 212.5 / 3392 (4.71, 557) | +36 % / +24 % |
| 8 | 208.4 / 7384 (4.80, 1362) | | 143.3 / 6126 (6.98, 1176) | +45 % / +21 % |

concurrent requests, and TP8 for one request). This PR does not measure c >= 16.

### Accuracy

(`--tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel`) in both arms; the only difference is `--monokernel`. The

The stderr of one GSM8K score is about 0.005; the per-c differences go both ways. Three more runs at c = 16 (on the
head e2ed1f0): stock 0.9682 / 0.9689 / 0.9704, `--monokernel` 0.9727 / 0.9727 / 0.9742.

With the AgentX server flags (prefix caching on), GSM8K at c = 8: stock 0.9682 with acceptance length 4.526,

#### Accuracy contract: GPQA-Diamond, AIME25, RULER NIAH

## Details

### Hook point

- `MuseSpark1xForCausalLM.process_weights_after_loading` calls `maybe_attach_mono`. This runs after the per-layer quant
  finalize, so the experts are already in their shuffled kernel layout. The call is collective over the TP group.
  `MuseSpark1xModel.mono` is `None` without `--monokernel`.
- `MuseSpark1xModel.forward`: if `mono.try_forward(...)` returns the residual stream, the stock layer loop does not
  run. Otherwise the stock loop runs as before.
- `MuseSpark1xAttention.forward` ends in a new `back` (o-norm, o-gate, o_proj), and `MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer.forward`
  in a new `after_attention`. The monokernel runs layer 1 up to the attention with the stock functions and calls these
  two at the seams. The stock path calls the same code in the same order.
- `compute_logits` and `compute_logits_local` start an asynchronous read of the kernels' health words (every 64
  steps, outside graph capture). A peer-rank wait that timed out raises there, instead of a hang.
- The model runner, the scheduler and the attention backends are not changed.

### Eligibility

- At startup (default deny; one `ValueError` with every reason, agreed over the TP CPU group): gfx950 with 256 CUs,
  the checkpoint's text config, TP8 + `--enable-expert-parallel` (linear placement, no EPLB), no PP / DP / DCP / PCP,
  DSpark with 7 draft tokens, no LoRA, sleep mode or weight transfer, no KV connector or offloading, bf16 model and KV
  cache, Quark OCP-MXFP4 W4A4 experts on AITER (shuffled weights and scales), the fused QK-norm / RoPE / KV insert,
  `ROCM_AITER_FA`.
- Every step, from rank-invariant data only (the batch shape and the attention metadata counts, because all ranks
  must take the same path). The step must be a uniform verify step of 1-16 requests x 8 tokens, in FULL CUDA graph
  or eager mode, with dense bf16 LBHNC KV caches (block size 16). All other steps run stock.

### Buckets

| rows (requests) | build | launches a layer |
|---|---|---|
| 8 (1), 16 (2) | K3, S = 8 / 16 | 1 |
| 24-32 (3-4) | HA + HM + HB, S = 32 | 3 |
| 40-128 (5-16) | HA + HM + HB, S = 64 / 96 / 128 (rows padded up; `nrows` = real rows) | 3 |

`--max-num-seqs` selects the builds that the server compiles. Weights are views of vLLM's parameters. The kernels
write KV into vLLM's pages through `slot_mapping` (padding slots are skipped). The peer buffers are plain `cudaMalloc`
memory, opened over IPC on the TP CPU group. All launch arguments are fixed pointers, so vLLM's FULL CUDA graphs
capture the launches.

### Fused verify attention (8, 16 and 32 rows)

From layer 2 on, layer i's verify attention runs at the head of K3_i / HA_i, for both the sliding-window and the full
layers. It is split over all 256 CTAs by (request, KV head, key range) and merged before o_proj. It reads the layer's
bf16 KV cache through its KV cache group's `block_table` / `seq_lens`, the impl's softmax scale, and the window
(2047, 0). Only blocks inside the window are read. The descriptor tables hold pointers and counts only. They are
keyed by their contents and written once, so captured graphs read fixed tables. If `max_model_len` is above the 1M
keys that the builds stage block ids for, vLLM's op runs. Builds of 40 rows and more keep vLLM's op.

### Numerics: a16w4, opt-in behind `--monokernel`

The kernels keep the MoE activations in bf16 (MXFP4 weights x bf16 activations). The stock path is W4A4: it
quantizes the expert inputs and the SwiGLU output to MXFP4. Thus `--monokernel` output is close to the stock output,
but not bit-identical. Prefill runs stock (W4A4). Other differences are the reduction order (fixed rank order in fp32)
and the bf16 norm multipliers. The flag help, the module README and the recipe describe this.

### Known issues

- With the DFlash2 draft (not the recipe's draft), `--monokernel` lowers the real acceptance length: AgentX c = 4
  4.83 -> 3.52. The aux-hidden-state bookkeeping is the same as in the stock loop: the new tests compare the aux
  states for the DSpark, DFlash2 and seam target layers. The cause is open (per-rank draft divergence, or a draft
  that is more sensitive to the a16w4 numerics). The recipe's DSpark draft is not affected on AgentX (2.83 vs 2.87).
- The FlyDSL cleanup keeps some unused launch arguments (the timeline and EPLB-replica pointers) and LDS slots. With
  them, every build compiles to the same code objects as the validated kernels: identical `.text` for all 30 server
  builds.
- CI cannot run the kernels: they need 8x MI355X and the checkpoint's shapes. The CI test runs the host side on one
  MI355X (below). The kernel paths were validated with the serving runs above.

### Vendored kernels

`vllm/models/muse_spark/amd/mono/kernels/` (about 6.7k lines) holds AMD's Muse Spark FlyDSL monokernel sources,
reduced to the builds that vLLM launches. They carry their MIT license header after vLLM's SPDX lines (as in
`rocm_block32_gemm.py`). They import FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers only when the monokernel attaches. The host code
(mono/ without kernels/, model.py and two small core edits) is about 1.3k lines.

### Test plan

```bash
pytest -v -s tests/models/test_muse_spark_rocm_mono.py tests/models/test_muse_spark_logits_local.py \
  tests/models/test_muse_spark_rocm_loading.py
pre-commit run --files $(git diff --name-only origin/main)
```

- On the head e2ed1f0 (main 3d81a51): 1x MI355X: 47 passed (39 s), on the vLLM ROCm nightly image 00b6c4c with the
  Python files of this branch. Pre-commit: all hooks pass.
- `test_muse_spark_rocm_mono.py` builds a tiny real MuseSpark1x model (Quark MXFP4 experts, `ROCM_AITER_FA`, LBHNC bf16
  KV cache). It loads the model through the dummy loader + `load_weights` + `process_weights_after_loading`, and runs
  it with real attention metadata builders and bound KV caches.
  - Guards: refused before the weight finalize, accepted after it. Config and deployment guards use real vLLM
    configs.
  - Weight views alias vLLM's parameters.
  - Step tests (7 shapes x 3 aux-layer sets: the DSpark and DFlash2 drafts' layers and the stock / mono seams): the
    FlyDSL launches build only for the checkpoint's TEP8 shapes. The test runs each launch as the stock layer pieces
    that it replaces, on the device memory at the pointers that the host passes. Hidden states and the KV caches of
    all layers are bit-exact vs the stock loop. Aux hidden states match at fp32 rounding. Prefill, mixed, short-query,
    too-wide and PIECEWISE steps run stock.
  - Mutants fail these tests: aux shifted by one layer, dropped aux gather, wrong q buffer for the fused attention,
    KV written to the wrong layer, dropped stock layer-1 aux.
- The test is in the `Basic Models (Other)` step and its MI355 mirror (`models_basic.yaml`).

### Follow-ups

- Move to the RFC #60904 layout (`vllm/models/muse_spark/amd/specialized_decode/`, tests under
  `tests/models/muse_spark/`) in a separate PR.
- A TP8 numerics test on 8x MI355X: each launch vs vLLM's layer on random full-size weights, as
  `test_dsv41_mono_numerics.py` does.
- Fused attention for the 40-128-row builds (c >= 5).
- Remove the unused launch arguments and LDS slots (this changes the code objects, so it needs a new validation).
- The DFlash2 acceptance drop (known issues).

### AI assistance

This PR was developed with AI assistance (Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5). The submitter reviewed every changed line
and ran the tests and benchmarks listed above.

+"""Host side of the Muse Spark monokernel (``--monokernel``).
+
+The guards run on real vLLM configs and on a tiny real MuseSpark1x model
+(Quark MXFP4 experts, ROCm AITER FA, a bf16 LBHNC KV cache). The FlyDSL
+launches build only for the TEP8 checkpoint shapes, so the step tests run
+them as the stock layer pieces they replace: from layer i's attention output
+to layer i+1's q, o-gate and KV insert, reading and writing the device
+memory at the pointers the host passes. A mono step must then match the
+stock layer loop: hidden states, aux hidden states and KV caches.

+def _params(head: str, world_size: int, tail: str) -> list[str]:
+    """A launch's parameters in order."""
+    return head.split() + [f"peer{r}" for r in range(world_size)] + tail.split()
+
+
+def _device_view(ptr: int, shape, dtype: torch.dtype, strides=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The device memory at ``ptr`` as a tensor, as a launch reads it."""
+    strides = strides or torch.empty(shape, device="meta").stride()
+    extent = 1 + sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(shape, strides))
+    nbytes = extent * torch.empty((), dtype=dtype).element_size()
+
+    class _Memory:
+        __cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+    raw = torch.as_tensor(_Memory(), device="cuda")
+    return raw.view(dtype).as_strided(shape, strides)
+
+
+class StockLaunches:
+    """The FlyDSL monokernel sources, with each launch running the stock layer
+    pieces it replaces on the memory at its arguments' pointers."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model, dims: MonoDims, bnd: int) -> None:
+        self.model, self.dims, self.bnd = model, dims, bnd
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
+        self.pending: dict[int, dict] = {}
+        self.kernels = MonoKernels(
+            *(_Kernel(self, name) for name in ("k3", "k5", "k5m")), _AttnFrag()
+        )
+
+    def launcher(self, name: str, params: list[str], run):
+        signature = inspect.Signature(
+            [inspect.Parameter(p, inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY) for p in params]
+            + [inspect.Parameter("stream", inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY)]
+        )
+
+        def launch(*args, **kwargs):
+            bound = dict(signature.bind(*args, **kwargs).arguments)
+            self.calls.append((name, bound))
+            run(bound)
+
+        return launch
+
+    def _attention(
+        self, i: int, attn_o: int, rows: int, nreq: int, fused: bool
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Layer i's attention output: at ``attn_o``, or, for a fused build,
+        run here from the descriptor row at ``attn_o``."""
+        layer = self.model.layers[i]
+        d = self.dims
+        if not fused:
+            return _device_view(attn_o, (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16)
+        words = _device_view(attn_o, (_DESC_WORDS,), torch.int64).tolist()
+        md, _, kv_cache, _ = _attention_context(layer)
+        assert words[1:5] == [
+            kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.stride(0),
+            md.block_table.data_ptr(),
+            md.seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+        ]
+        assert words[8] == nreq
+        q = _device_view(words[0], (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16)
+        out = _device_view(words[5], (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16)
+        out.copy_(layer.self_attn.attn(q, None, None))
+        return out
+
+    def run_layer(self, rows: int, a: dict, b: dict) -> None:
+        """Layer i from its attention output (launch ``a``) to layer i+1's q,
+        o-gate and stream (launch ``b``)."""
+        i, nreq = a["layer"], rows // ROWS_PER_REQUEST
+        d, layer, nxt = self.dims, self.model.layers[i], self.model.layers[i + 1]
+        o = self._attention(i, a["attn_o"], rows, nreq, a["fused"])
+        g = _device_view(
+            a["attn_g"], (rows, d.q_rows), torch.bfloat16, (a["g_stride"], 1)
+        )
+        stream = _device_view(a["stream"], (rows, d.hidden_size), torch.float32)
+        positions = _device_view(b["pos"], (rows,), torch.int64)
+        _, _, kv_cache, slots = _attention_context(nxt)
+        assert b["k_cache"] == kv_cache.data_ptr()
+        assert b["v_cache"] == kv_cache.stride(0)
+        assert b["slots"] == slots.data_ptr()
+        rope = nxt.self_attn.rotary_emb
+        if rope is not None:
+            assert b["cos_sin"] == rope.cos_sin_cache.data_ptr()
+
+        y = layer.after_attention(stream, layer.self_attn.back(o, g))
+        attn_input, stream_next = norm_residual_then_norm(
+            y, nxt.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm, out_dtype=nxt.default_dtype
+        )
+        qkv, _ = nxt.self_attn.qkv_proj(attn_input)
+        q, _, _, g_next = nxt.self_attn._qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(qkv, positions)
+        streams = ["stream_out"] + (["sfull_out"] if b.get("gather") else [])
+        for names, t in ((streams, stream_next), (["q_out"], q), (["g_out"], g_next)):
+            for name in names:
+                _device_view(b[name], t.shape, t.dtype).copy_(t)
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _Key:
+    S: int
+    W: int
+    next_rope: bool = True
+    attn: str = ""
+    bnd: int = 0
+
+
+class _Kernel:
+    """One FlyDSL source module: its layouts and builds."""
+
+    BLOCKS = 4
+    HEALTH_WORDS = 8 + 8 * BLOCKS
+    TL_POINTS = 4
+
+    def __init__(self, owner: StockLaunches, name: str) -> None:
+        self.owner, self.name = owner, name
+
+    def peer_layout(self, S, W, bnd=0):
+        return {}, 4096
+
+    def scratch_layout(self, S, W=1, bnd=0):
+        return {}, 4096
+
+    def build_vllm(self, S, W, next_rope=True, attn=""):
+        return _Key(S, W, next_rope, attn, self.owner.bnd if self.name == "k5" else 0)
+
+    def build(self, key: _Key):
+        o, w = self.owner, key.W
+        if self.name == "k3":
+            params = _params(_K3_HEAD, w, "layer rank g_stride" + _REPLICAS)
+            return o.launcher("k3", params, lambda a: _run_k3(o, key, a))
+        if self.name == "k5m":
+            params = _params(_HM_HEAD, w, "layer rank nrows" + _REPLICAS)
+            return o.launcher("hm", params, lambda a: None)
+        ha = _params(_HA_HEAD, w, "layer rank g_stride s_full nrows")
+        hb = _params(_HB_HEAD, w, "layer rank so_stride so_off gather nrows")
+
+        def run_ha(a):
+            o.pending[a["layer"]] = a | {"fused": bool(key.attn)}
+
+        return (
+            o.launcher("ha", ha, run_ha),
+            o.launcher("hb", hb, lambda a: _run_hb(o, key, a)),
+        )
+
+
+class _AttnFrag:
+    TABLE_ROWS = 64
+    DESC_WORDS = _DESC_WORDS
+    VLLM_MAX_KEYS = 1 << 20
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def part_bytes() -> int:
+        return 4096
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def vllm_desc(q, kv_cache, block_table, seq_lens, out, part, nreq, scale):
+        return [
+            q.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.stride(0),
+            block_table.data_ptr(),
+            seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+            out.data_ptr(),
+            part.data_ptr(),
+            block_table.stride(0),
+            nreq,
+            0,
+        ]
+
+
+def _run_k3(o: StockLaunches, key: _Key, a: dict) -> None:
+    o.run_layer(key.S, a | {"stream": a["stream_pre"], "fused": bool(key.attn)}, a)
+
+
+def _run_hb(o: StockLaunches, key: _Key, b: dict) -> None:
+    a = o.pending.pop(b["layer"])
+    assert a["nrows"] == b["nrows"]
+    o.run_layer(b["nrows"], a | {"stream": a["stream_in"]}, b)
+

+def _attention_context(layer):
+    return get_attention_context(layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name)

+class Step:
+    """One verify step's real attention metadata and KV caches."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tiny: TinyModel, query_lens: list[int], seed: int) -> None:
+        from tests.v1.attention.utils import (
+            BatchSpec,
+            create_common_attn_metadata,
+            dense_kv_cache_views,
+        )
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import AiterFlashAttentionBackend
+        from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+
+        device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+        seq_lens = [
+            int(torch.randint(40, 300, (), generator=generator)) + q for q in query_lens
+        ]
+        self.common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+            BatchSpec(seq_lens=seq_lens, query_lens=query_lens),
+            16,
+            device,
+            arange_block_indices=True,
+        )
+        num_blocks = int(self.common.block_table_tensor.max()) + 1
+        builder_cls = AiterFlashAttentionBackend.get_builder_cls()
+        self.names = [layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name for layer in tiny.layers]
+        self.metadata: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        self.kv_caches: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        for kind, spec in tiny.kv_specs.items():
+            names = [
+                n
+                for n, layer in zip(self.names, tiny.layers)
+                if (layer.self_attn.attn.impl.sliding_window == (2047, 0))
+                == (kind == "swa")
+            ]
+            builder = builder_cls(spec, names, tiny.vllm_config, device)
+            metadata = builder.build(0, self.common)
+            for name in names:
+                raw = torch.zeros(
+                    num_blocks * spec.page_size_bytes, dtype=torch.int8, device=device
+                )
+                (view,) = dense_kv_cache_views(
+                    raw, spec, num_blocks, 1, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC
+                )
+                self.metadata[name] = metadata
+                self.kv_caches[name] = view
+        self.tokens = sum(query_lens)
+        self.input_ids = torch.randint(
+            0, TINY_TEXT["vocab_size"], (self.tokens,), generator=generator
+        ).to(device)
+        self.positions = torch.cat(
+            [torch.arange(s - q, s) for s, q in zip(seq_lens, query_lens)]
+        ).to(device)
+
+    def run(self, tiny: TinyModel, mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE):
+        """MuseSpark1xModel.forward on zeroed KV caches; returns the hidden
+        states, the aux hidden states and the KV caches after the step."""
+        from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+        from vllm.v1.worker.utils import bind_kv_cache
+
+        for cache in self.kv_caches.values():
+            cache.zero_()
+        context = tiny.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        bind_kv_cache(self.kv_caches, context, [])
+        slots = dict.fromkeys(self.names, self.common.slot_mapping)
+        with (
+            set_current_vllm_config(tiny.vllm_config),
+            set_forward_context(
+                self.metadata,
+                tiny.vllm_config,
+                num_tokens=self.tokens,
+                cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode,
+                slot_mapping=slots,
+            ),
+        ):
+            out = tiny.model(self.input_ids, self.positions, None)
+        hidden, aux = out if isinstance(out, tuple) else (out, [])
+        kv = {name: cache.clone() for name, cache in self.kv_caches.items()}
+        return hidden.clone(), [a.clone() for a in aux], kv
+
+
+def _run_mono(
+    tiny: TinyModel, step: Step, bnd: int, buckets: list[int], mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE
+):
+    """The step with the monokernel attached, on the stock launches."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+    launches = StockLaunches(tiny.model, tiny.dims, bnd)
+    tiny.model.mono = MuseSparkMono(
+        tiny.model,
+        launches.kernels,
+        rank=0,
+        group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device("cuda", 0),
+        dims=tiny.dims,
+        buckets=buckets,
+        fused_attention=fused_attention_layers(
+            tiny.layers, 4096, _AttnFrag.VLLM_MAX_KEYS
+        ),
+    )
+    try:
+        return launches, step.run(tiny, mode)
+    finally:
+        tiny.model.mono.close()
+        tiny.model.mono = None

+def _assert_same_step(stock, mono) -> None:
+    (hidden_s, aux_s, kv_s), (hidden_m, aux_m, kv_m) = stock, mono
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hidden_m, hidden_s, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    for name in kv_s:

+    assert len(aux_m) == len(aux_s)

+    # blend the next layer's input norm makes: fp32 rounding apart.
+    for a_m, a_s in zip(aux_m, aux_s):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(a_m, a_s, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)

+# Muse Spark decode monokernel (MI355X, FlyDSL)
+
+`--monokernel` for `MuseSpark1xForCausalLM` on MI355X: decoder layers 1-60 of
+a speculative verify step run as persistent FlyDSL launches, from one layer's
+attention output to the next layer's q, o-gate and KV insert. vLLM's own
+attention op runs between the launches, except where a launch runs the
+attention itself (below); layer 0, layer 61 and every step the kernels do not
+cover run vLLM's stock path.
+
+## Scope
+
+- Deployment (checked at startup; a deployment that cannot run the kernels
+  raises): gfx950 with 256 CUs, tensor parallel size 8 with
+  `--enable-expert-parallel` (linear placement, 32 experts a rank, no EPLB),
+  no PP / DP / DCP / PCP, Quark OCP-MXFP4 W4A4 experts on `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4`
+  (shuffled weights and scales), the fused QK-norm / RoPE / KV insert,
+  `ROCM_AITER_FA` with a bf16 KV cache in the LBHNC layout (block size 16),
+  DSpark with 7 draft tokens, no LoRA, sleep mode or weight transfer, no KV
+  connector or offloading.
+- Steps (checked every forward; anything else runs stock): uniform decode
+  verify batches of 1-16 requests x 8 tokens, FULL CUDA graph or eager.
+  8 / 16 rows run K3 (S = 8 / 16); 24-128 rows run HA + HM + HB with the rows
+  padded up to S = 32 / 64 / 96 / 128 (`nrows` = the real rows).
+
+## Launches (layer i, 1 <= i <= 60)
+
+    K3  o-norm x gate, o_proj, all-reduce, attention boundary (post-attn norm,
+        gated residual, pre-FFN norm), router + pre-expert projection, top-8,
+        pre-expert norm, the local experts (gate-up, SwiGLU, down, post-expert
+        norm, weighted sum), EP all-reduce, post-expert projection, FFN
+        boundary (post-FFN norm, gated residual, layer i+1's input norm),
+        layer i+1's QKV + O-gate GEMV, QK-norm, RoPE, KV insert
+    HA  K3 up to the pre-expert norm; the residual stream token-sharded
+    HM  the local experts; the partials pushed to their owner ranks
+    HB  EP reduce, post-expert projection, FFN boundary, QKV, KV insert; the
+        stream all-gathered only where a full copy is read (DSpark aux layers,
+        layer 61)
+
+Fused attention: at 8, 16 and 24-32 rows every layer from layer 2 runs its
+verify attention at the head of K3_i / HA_i (`kernels/attn_frag.py`) instead
+of vLLM's op: split over all 256 CTAs by
+(request, kv head, key range), then merged before o_proj. It reads layer i's
+q from the previous launch, layer i's bf16 KV cache through its KV cache
+group's `block_table` (int32) and `seq_lens` (int32), the softmax scale of the
+layer's attention impl, and for sliding-window layers vLLM's window (2047, 0)
+(only blocks inside the window are read). The builds stage block ids for up
+to 1M keys a request; with a larger `max_model_len` every layer runs vLLM's
+op. 40-128 rows keep vLLM's op.
+
+## Contract with vLLM
+
+- Weights: read in place from vLLM's parameters (`kernels/` builds take
+  vLLM's layouts): QKV + O-gate rows `[q | k | v | o_gate]` per rank,
+  `o_proj`, the fp32 router with the output multiplier folded in (rows
+  `[32 r, 32 r + 32)`), `pooler` / `unpooler` row slices, the experts after
+  `shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16))` and the scales after `e8m0_shuffle`. The
+  norm multipliers are small bf16 copies (`weight + gain_center`).
+- KV: layer i+1's `kv_cache` `[block][kv head][16 tokens][K 64 | V 64]` bf16
+  and its group's `slot_mapping` (`slot < 0` = graph padding, skipped); the
+  block stride is a launch argument.
+- Fused attention: one descriptor table a build and step shape (10 words a
+  layer: q, KV cache and block stride, block table and row stride, seq_lens,
+  output, scratch, request count, scale). Tables are keyed by their contents
+  and written once (a pinned-buffer copy when first seen during graph capture).
+- q leaves without the QK scale: vLLM's attention applies
+  `0.125 * qk_scale_factor` as its softmax scale.
+- Peers: one `cudaMalloc` buffer a rank and build, opened by every rank through
+  IPC handles exchanged on the TP CPU group (plain device memory, not the
+  uncached custom all-reduce buffers). Buffers are allocated at load time and
+  every launch argument is a fixed pointer, so the launches are captured in
+  vLLM's FULL graphs.
+- Health: a wait on a peer rank times out instead of hanging and leaves a
+  record in the build's health words; `compute_logits` copies them back
+  asynchronously every 64 steps and raises on a timeout.
+
+## Numerics
+
+The kernels keep the MoE activations in bf16 (MXFP4 weights x bf16
+activations). The stock W4A4 path quantizes the expert inputs and the SwiGLU
+output to MXFP4, so `--monokernel` outputs differ from the stock path (and
+prefill, which runs stock, uses W4A4). Other differences are reduction order
+(router, GEMVs, all-reduces in rank order) and the bf16 norm multipliers.

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MonoDims:
+    """Per-rank tensor sizes of a TP = EP rank."""
+
+    world_size: int
+    hidden_size: int
+    pooled_size: int
+    intermediate_size: int
+    num_experts: int
+    num_heads: int
+    num_kv_heads: int
+    head_dim: int
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_config(cls, config: Any, world_size: int) -> "MonoDims":
+        return cls(
+            world_size=world_size,
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            pooled_size=config.moe_hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            num_experts=config.num_local_experts,
+            num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=config.num_key_value_heads,
+            head_dim=config.head_dim,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def local_experts(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_experts // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def local_kv_heads(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_kv_heads // self.world_size
+
+    @property
+    def q_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_heads // self.world_size * self.head_dim
+
+    @property
+    def kv_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.local_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+
+    @property
+    def qkvg_rows(self) -> int:
+        return 2 * self.q_rows + 2 * self.kv_rows
+
+    def expert_shapes(self) -> dict[str, tuple[int, ...]]:
+        """MXFP4 expert tensors of the local experts, as uint8."""
+        e, h, i = self.local_experts, self.pooled_size, self.intermediate_size
+        return {
+            "w13_weight": (e, 2 * i, h // 2),
+            "w13_weight_scale": (e, 2 * i, h // 32),
+            "w2_weight": (e, h, i // 2),
+            "w2_weight_scale": (e, h, i // 32),
+        }
+
+
+def bucket_of(rows: int) -> int | None:
+    """The kernel build that serves ``rows`` (padded up); None = stock."""
+    if rows <= 0 or rows % ROWS_PER_REQUEST:
+        return None
+    if rows in K3_ROWS:
+        return rows
+    return next((s for s in K5_ROWS if rows <= s), None)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LayerWeights:
+    """Views of vLLM's parameters (and small norm copies) for layer i's launches."""
+
+    w_o: torch.Tensor
+    alpha_a: torch.Tensor
+    beta_a: torch.Tensor
+    w_pffn: torch.Tensor
+    w_r: torch.Tensor
+    bias: torch.Tensor
+    w_pre: torch.Tensor
+    w_pren: torch.Tensor
+    w13: torch.Tensor
+    w13s: torch.Tensor
+    w2: torch.Tensor
+    w2s: torch.Tensor
+    w_post: torch.Tensor
+    w_pp: torch.Tensor
+    w_pff: torch.Tensor
+    alpha: torch.Tensor
+    beta: torch.Tensor
+    w_in: torch.Tensor
+    w_qkvg: torch.Tensor

+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        def ptrs(names: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+            return tuple(getattr(self, n).data_ptr() for n in names.split())
+
+        # HA (and K3): attention boundary, router and pre-expert projection;
+        # HM: the local experts; HB: post-expert projection, FFN boundary and
+        # the next QKV. Without EPLB replicas, the replica arguments are the
+        # own experts.
+        self.ha = ptrs("w_o alpha_a beta_a w_pffn w_r bias w_pre w_pren")
+        self.hm = ptrs("w13 w13s w2 w2s w_post")
+        self.hb = ptrs("w_pp w_pff alpha beta w_in w_qkvg")
+        self.replicas = ptrs("w13 w13s w2 w2s w13")

+
+def effective_norm_weight(norm: nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The bf16 multiplier the kernel applies: ``weight (+ gain_center)``."""
+    weight = norm.weight.detach().float()
+    if norm.zero_centered_gamma:
+        weight = weight + norm.gain_center
+    return weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+
+
+def _routed_experts(layer: nn.Module) -> nn.Module | None:
+    experts = getattr(layer.feed_forward, "experts", None)
+    return getattr(experts, "routed_experts", None)
+
+
+def _rows(t: torch.Tensor, rank: int, n: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return t.detach()[rank * n : (rank + 1) * n]
+
+
+def collect_layer_weights(
+    layers: Sequence[nn.Module], i: int, rank: int, dims: MonoDims
+) -> LayerWeights:
+    """Layer i's kernel weights from decoder layers ``i`` and ``i + 1``; no copy."""
+    layer, nxt = layers[i], layers[i + 1]
+    moe = layer.feed_forward
+    experts = _routed_experts(layer)
+    assert experts is not None
+    w = dims.world_size

+        w_o=layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight.detach(),
+        alpha_a=layer.add_attn.alpha,
+        beta_a=layer.add_attn.beta,
+        w_pffn=effective_norm_weight(layer.pre_ffn_norm),
+        w_r=_rows(moe.router.weight, rank, dims.num_experts // w),
+        bias=moe.expert_bias,
+        w_pre=_rows(moe.pooler.weight, rank, dims.pooled_size // w),
+        w_pren=effective_norm_weight(moe.pre_expert_norm),
+        w13=experts.w13_weight.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w13s=experts.w13_weight_scale.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w2=experts.w2_weight.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w2s=experts.w2_weight_scale.detach().view(torch.uint8),
+        w_post=effective_norm_weight(moe.post_expert_norm),
+        w_pp=_rows(moe.unpooler.weight, rank, dims.hidden_size // w),
+        w_pff=effective_norm_weight(layer.post_ffn_norm),
+        alpha=layer.add_ffn.alpha,
+        beta=layer.add_ffn.beta,
+        w_in=effective_norm_weight(nxt.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm),
+        w_qkvg=nxt.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight.detach(),
+        next_rope=nxt.self_attn.rotary_emb is not None,

+
+def config_refusals(config: Any) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for name, want in KERNEL_CONFIG.items():
+        got = getattr(config, name, None)
+        if not isinstance(got, (int, float)) or abs(got - want) > 1e-12 * max(
+            1.0, abs(want)
+        ):
+            reasons.append(f"config.{name}={got} (kernel: {want})")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def deployment_refusals(
+    vllm_config: Any, tp_rank: int, tp_size: int, moe_parallel: Any
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Parallel layout and server features the monokernel does not support."""
+    reasons = []
+    parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if tp_size != WORLD_SIZE:
+        reasons.append(f"tensor_parallel_size={tp_size} (kernel: {WORLD_SIZE})")
+    for name in (
+        "pipeline_parallel_size",
+        "data_parallel_size",
+        "decode_context_parallel_size",
+        "prefill_context_parallel_size",
+    ):

+            reasons.append(f"{name}={getattr(parallel, name)}")

+        reasons.append("expert parallelism off (needs --enable-expert-parallel)")
+    if parallel.enable_eplb:
+        reasons.append("EPLB on")
+    if parallel.expert_placement_strategy != "linear":
+        reasons.append(f"expert placement {parallel.expert_placement_strategy}")
+    if moe_parallel is None or not moe_parallel.use_ep:
+        reasons.append("MoE layers not expert parallel")
+    elif moe_parallel.ep_size != tp_size or moe_parallel.ep_rank != tp_rank:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"EP rank {moe_parallel.ep_rank}/{moe_parallel.ep_size} "
+            f"!= TP rank {tp_rank}/{tp_size}"
+        )
+    spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if spec is None or spec.num_speculative_tokens != ROWS_PER_REQUEST - 1:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"needs speculative decoding with {ROWS_PER_REQUEST - 1} draft tokens"
+        )

+        reasons.append("LoRA on")
+    if vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode:
+        reasons.append("sleep mode on")
+    if vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None:
+        reasons.append("weight transfer on")
+    if vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None:
+        reasons.append("KV connector on")

+        reasons.append(f"model dtype {vllm_config.model_config.dtype}")

+
+
+def _shape(t: torch.Tensor | None) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
+    return None if t is None else tuple(t.shape)
+
+

+            moe, "_router_multiplier_folded", False
+        ):

+            getattr(experts.w13_weight, "is_shuffled", False)
+            and getattr(experts.w2_weight, "is_shuffled", False)
+        ):
+            bad(f"layer {i}: expert weights not shuffled")
+        for e_n in (2 * dims.intermediate_size, dims.pooled_size):
+            if dims.local_experts * e_n % 256:

+
+def kv_cache_refusal(kv_cache: torch.Tensor, kv_heads: int) -> str | None:
+    """K3 writes bf16 LBHNC pages: ``[block][kv head][16 tokens][K | V]``."""
+    if kv_cache.numel() == 0:
+        return "kv:unbound"
+    if kv_cache.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        return f"kv:{kv_cache.dtype}"
+    want_shape = (kv_heads, KV_BLOCK_SIZE, 2 * 64)
+    if tuple(kv_cache.shape[1:]) != want_shape:
+        return f"kv:shape{tuple(kv_cache.shape)}"
+    if tuple(kv_cache.stride()[1:]) != (KV_BLOCK_SIZE * 128, 128, 1):
+        return f"kv:stride{tuple(kv_cache.stride())}"
+    return None
+
+
+def attention_type(layer: nn.Module) -> str | None:
+    """``"swa"`` / ``"full"`` when the fused attention can run layer's
+    attention (vLLM's ``sliding_window`` (2047, 0) or none); else None."""
+    window = getattr(
+        getattr(layer.self_attn.attn, "impl", None), "sliding_window", None
+    )
+    if window == SLIDING_WINDOW:
+        return "swa"
+    if window in (None, (-1, -1)):
+        return "full"
+    return None
+
+
+def fused_attention_layers(
+    layers: Sequence[nn.Module], max_model_len: int, max_keys: int
+) -> dict[int, str]:
+    """Layers whose attention the launches can fuse: ``{i: type}``.
+
+    Empty when a request may hold more keys than a build stages block ids for.
+    """
+    if max_model_len > max_keys:
+        return {}
+    fused = {}
+    for i in range(FIRST_LAYER + 1, LAST_LAYER + 1):
+        kind = attention_type(layers[i])
+        if kind is not None:
+            fused[i] = kind
+    return fused
+
+
+def batch_refusal(
+    num_tokens: int, forward_context: Any, layer_names: Sequence[str]
+) -> str | None:
+    """Why this step runs stock, from rank-invariant data only; None = mono.
+
+    Reads the attention metadata of the kernels' layers (``layer_names``) only:
+    the dict also holds the draft model's layers.
+    """
+    if bucket_of(num_tokens) is None:
+        return f"rows:{num_tokens}"
+    mode = forward_context.cudagraph_runtime_mode
+    if mode not in (CUDAGraphMode.NONE, CUDAGraphMode.FULL):
+        return f"cudagraph:{mode.name}"
+    metadata = forward_context.attn_metadata
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not metadata:
+        return "attn-metadata"
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+    for name in layer_names:
+        md = metadata.get(name)
+        if md is None:
+            return "attn-metadata"
+        if id(md) in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(id(md))
+        decode = getattr(md, "decode_metadata", None)
+        if (
+            getattr(md, "num_prefills", None) != 0
+            or getattr(md, "num_extends", None) != 0
+            or decode is None
+        ):
+            return "not-decode"
+        if decode.max_query_len != ROWS_PER_REQUEST:
+            return f"query-len:{decode.max_query_len}"
+        if md.num_decodes * ROWS_PER_REQUEST != num_tokens:
+            return f"width:{num_tokens}/{md.num_decodes}"

+class MonoKernels:
+    """The FlyDSL kernel modules (``kernels.k3``, ``k5``, ``k5m``, ``attn_frag``)."""
+
+    k3: ModuleType
+    k5: ModuleType
+    k5m: ModuleType

+class _FusedAttention:
+    """The fused attention of one build: its output, scratch and descriptor
+    tables (``kernels/attn_frag.py``; row i = layer i).
+
+    A table holds pointers and counts only (q, KV cache, block table,
+    seq_lens, output, request count, scale). Tables are keyed by their
+    contents, so one is written once and never changes after a CUDA graph
+    captured a launch that reads it.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        attn_frag: ModuleType,
+        layers: dict[int, str],
+        scales: dict[int, float],
+        rows: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.af = attn_frag
+        self.layers = layers
+        self.scales = scales
+        self.out = torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.part = torch.zeros(
+            attn_frag.part_bytes() // 4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.words = attn_frag.TABLE_ROWS * attn_frag.DESC_WORDS
+        self.device = device
+        self.tables: dict[tuple, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        # Pinned sources of the table copies captured in CUDA graphs: a pinned
+        # allocation is not allowed while a stream captures.
+        self._pinned = [
+            torch.zeros(self.words, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=True)
+            for _ in range(8)
+        ]
+        self._keep: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+
+    def table(
+        self, layers: Sequence[nn.Module], q_of: Any, num_reqs: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The descriptor table of this step; ``q_of(i)`` = layer i's q."""
+        rows = {}
+        for i in self.layers:
+            md, _, kv_cache, _ = get_attention_context(
+                layers[i].self_attn.attn.layer_name
+            )
+            rows[i] = self.af.vllm_desc(
+                q_of(i),
+                kv_cache,
+                md.block_table,
+                md.seq_lens,
+                self.out,
+                self.part,
+                num_reqs,
+                self.scales[i],
+            )
+        key = tuple((i, *w) for i, w in rows.items())
+        table = self.tables.get(key)
+        if table is not None:
+            return table
+        host = torch.zeros(self.words, dtype=torch.int64)
+        n = self.af.DESC_WORDS
+        for i, w in rows.items():
+            host[i * n : (i + 1) * n] = torch.tensor(w, dtype=torch.int64)
+        table = torch.zeros(self.words, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            if not self._pinned:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "Muse Spark monokernel: more fused-attention tables than "
+                    "pinned buffers"
+                )
+            pinned = self._pinned.pop()
+            pinned.copy_(host)
+            self._keep.append(pinned)
+            table.copy_(pinned, non_blocking=True)
+        else:
+            table.copy_(host)
+        self.tables[key] = table
+        return table
+
+    def row(self, table: torch.Tensor, i: int) -> int:
+        return table.data_ptr() + i * self.af.DESC_WORDS * table.element_size()
+

+class _Bucket:
+    """Launchers and persistent buffers of one kernel build (row count)."""
+
+    q: list[torch.Tensor]
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kernel: ModuleType,
+        peer_bytes: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.dims = dims
+        self.blocks = kernel.BLOCKS
+        self.peers = PeerBuffer(peer_bytes + 256, group)
+        self.epoch = torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.health = torch.zeros(kernel.HEALTH_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.timeline = torch.zeros(
+            kernel.BLOCKS * kernel.TL_POINTS, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+        self.no_rope = torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self.fa: _FusedAttention | None = None
+
+    def _common(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return (
+            self.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            self.health.data_ptr(),
+            self.timeline.data_ptr(),
+            *self.peers.pointers,
+        )
+
+    def run(self, mono, layers, positions, o, g, stream, aux_layers, aux_hidden_states):
+        """Layers FIRST_LAYER..LAST_LAYER; returns layer 61's (stream, q, g)."""
+        q, fa, table = o, self.fa, None
+        if fa is not None:
+            nreq = stream.shape[0] // ROWS_PER_REQUEST
+            table = fa.table(layers, lambda i: self.q[(i - 1) % 2], nreq)
+        for i in range(FIRST_LAYER, LAST_LAYER + 1):
+            kind = fa.layers.get(i) if fa is not None else None
+            if fa is not None and kind is not None:
+                attn_o = fa.row(table, i)
+            else:
+                if i > FIRST_LAYER:
+                    o = layers[i].self_attn.attn(q, None, None)
+                attn_o = o.data_ptr()
+            nxt = layers[i + 1].self_attn
+            _, _, kv_cache, slots = get_attention_context(nxt.attn.layer_name)
+            rope = nxt.rotary_emb
+            cos_sin = rope.cos_sin_cache if rope is not None else self.no_rope
+            ptrs = (slots.data_ptr(), cos_sin.data_ptr(), positions.data_ptr())
+            # The kernels take the block stride (elements) in the V slot.
+            kv = (kv_cache.data_ptr(), kv_cache.stride(0), *ptrs)
+            stream, q, g = self.layer(mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers)
+            if i + 1 in aux_layers:
+                aux_hidden_states.append(stream.clone())
+        return stream, q, g
+
+    def layer(self, mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers):
+        """Layer i's launches; returns layer i + 1's (stream, q, g)."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+

+class _K3Bucket(_Bucket):
+    """8 / 16 rows: one K3 launch a layer."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        k3: ModuleType,
+        rows: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+        fa: _FusedAttention | None = None,
+        fused_kinds: Sequence[tuple[bool, str]] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        w = dims.world_size
+        super().__init__(k3, k3.peer_layout(rows, w)[1], dims, device, group)
+        self.launchers = {
+            next_rope: k3.build(k3.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=next_rope))
+            for next_rope in (True, False)
+        }
+        self.fa = fa
+        self.fused_launchers = {
+            (next_rope, kind): k3.build(
+                k3.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=next_rope, attn=kind)
+            )
+            for next_rope, kind in fused_kinds
+        }
+        self.scratch = torch.zeros(
+            k3.scratch_layout(rows, w)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        bf16 = torch.bfloat16
+        self.outs = [
+            {
+                "stream": torch.zeros(
+                    rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+                ),
+                "xn": torch.zeros(rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+                "part": torch.zeros(rows, dims.pooled_size, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+                "q": torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+                "g": torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device),
+            }
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.q = [out["q"] for out in self.outs]
+
+    def layer(self, mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers):
+        a, out = mono.weights[i], self.outs[i % 2]
+        launch = (
+            self.launchers[a.next_rope]
+            if kind is None
+            else self.fused_launchers[(a.next_rope, kind)]
+        )
+        launch(
+            attn_o,
+            g.data_ptr(),
+            stream.data_ptr(),
+            *a.ha,
+            *a.hm,
+            *a.hb,
+            out["stream"].data_ptr(),
+            out["xn"].data_ptr(),
+            out["part"].data_ptr(),
+            out["q"].data_ptr(),
+            out["g"].data_ptr(),
+            *kv,
+            self.scratch.data_ptr(),
+            *self._common(),
+            i,
+            mono.rank,
+            g.stride(0),
+            *a.replicas,
+            stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        )
+        return out["stream"], out["q"], out["g"]
+
