+class _K5Bucket(_Bucket):
+    """24-128 rows: HA (attention boundary, router, pre-expert projection),
+    HM (the local experts) and HB (FFN boundary, next QKV) a layer; between
+    the launches the residual stream lives token-sharded unless the build
+    replicates it (``key.bnd``)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        k5: ModuleType,
+        k5m: ModuleType,
+        rows: int,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+        fa: _FusedAttention | None = None,
+        fused_kinds: Sequence[str] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        w = dims.world_size
+        key = k5.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=True)
+        super().__init__(k5, k5.peer_layout(rows, w, key.bnd)[1], dims, device, group)
+        self.bnd = key.bnd
+        self.launch_a, launch_b = k5.build(key)
+        self.launch_b = {
+            True: launch_b,
+            False: k5.build(dataclasses.replace(key, next_rope=False))[1],
+        }
+        self.launch_m = k5m.build(k5m.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w))
+        self.fa = fa
+        self.fused_launch_a = {
+            kind: k5.build(k5.build_vllm(S=rows, W=w, next_rope=True, attn=kind))[0]
+            for kind in fused_kinds
+        }
+        i32, f32, bf16 = torch.int32, torch.float32, torch.bfloat16
+        self.scratch = torch.zeros(
+            k5.scratch_layout(rows, w, key.bnd)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=i32, device=device
+        )
+        self.scratch_m = torch.zeros(
+            k5m.scratch_layout(rows)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=i32, device=device
+        )
+        self.timeline_m = torch.zeros(k5.BLOCKS * 8, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        topk = int(KERNEL_CONFIG["num_experts_per_tok"])
+        self.h = torch.zeros(rows, dims.pooled_size, dtype=bf16, device=device)
+        self.ids = torch.zeros(rows, topk, dtype=i32, device=device)
+        self.scores = torch.zeros(rows, topk, dtype=f32, device=device)
+        self.part = torch.zeros(rows, dims.pooled_size, dtype=bf16, device=device)
+        sharded_rows = rows // w if key.bnd < 2 else rows
+        self.ts = [
+            torch.zeros(sharded_rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=f32, device=device)
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.sfull = torch.zeros(rows, dims.hidden_size, dtype=f32, device=device)
+        self.next_in: tuple[torch.Tensor, int] = (self.sfull, 1)
+        self.q = [
+            torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device) for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.g = [
+            torch.zeros(rows, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device) for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+
+    def layer(self, mono, i, kind, attn_o, g, stream, kv, aux_layers):
+        nrows, a, cur = stream.shape[0], mono.weights[i], torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        s_in, s_full = (stream, 1) if i == FIRST_LAYER else self.next_in
+        launch_a = self.launch_a if kind is None else self.fused_launch_a[kind]
+        launch_a(
+            attn_o,
+            g.data_ptr(),
+            s_in.data_ptr(),
+            *a.ha,
+            self.h.data_ptr(),
+            self.ids.data_ptr(),
+            self.scores.data_ptr(),
+            self.scratch.data_ptr(),
+            *self._common(),
+            i,
+            mono.rank,
+            g.stride(0),
+            s_full,
+            nrows,
+            stream=cur,
+        )
+        self.launch_m(
+            self.h.data_ptr(),
+            self.ids.data_ptr(),
+            self.scores.data_ptr(),
+            *a.hm,
+            self.part.data_ptr(),
+            self.scratch_m.data_ptr(),
+            self.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            self.health.data_ptr(),
+            self.timeline_m.data_ptr(),
+            *self.peers.pointers,
+            i,
+            mono.rank,
+            nrows,
+            *a.replicas,
+            stream=cur,
+        )
+        gather = int(i == LAST_LAYER or i + 1 in aux_layers or self.bnd == 1)
+        ts, q_out, g_out = self.ts[i % 2], self.q[i % 2], self.g[i % 2]
+        self.launch_b[a.next_rope](
+            self.part.data_ptr(),
+            *a.hb,
+            ts.data_ptr(),
+            self.sfull.data_ptr(),
+            q_out.data_ptr(),
+            g_out.data_ptr(),
+            *kv,
+            self.scratch.data_ptr(),
+            *self._common(),
+            i,
+            mono.rank,
+            self.dims.hidden_size,
+            0,
+            gather,
+            nrows,
+            stream=cur,
+        )
+        self.next_in = (self.sfull, 1) if self.bnd == 1 else (ts, int(self.bnd >= 2))
+        return self.sfull[:nrows], q_out[:nrows], g_out[:nrows]
+

+def built_buckets(max_num_seqs: int) -> list[int]:
+    """The builds a server with ``max_num_seqs`` requests can use."""
+    max_rows = min(max_num_seqs, K5_ROWS[-1] // ROWS_PER_REQUEST) * ROWS_PER_REQUEST

+            b
+            for rows in range(ROWS_PER_REQUEST, max_rows + 1, ROWS_PER_REQUEST)
+            if (b := bucket_of(rows)) is not None
+        }
+    )

+"""FlyDSL sources of the Muse Spark decode monokernel (see ../README.md).

+``k3.build_vllm(S, W, next_rope)`` (8 / 16 rows), ``k5.build_vllm`` (HA / HB)
+and ``k5m.build_vllm`` (HM) for 32-128 rows are the builds vLLM launches:
+TP = EP = 8, the router output multiplier folded into the router weight, q
+without the QK scale, bf16 KV pages in vLLM's LBHNC layout, and vLLM's
+shuffled MXFP4 expert weights and scales read in place. With ``attn="swa"`` /
+``"full"`` the K3 / HA builds also run the layer's verify attention at their
+head (``attn_frag.make``: vLLM's bf16 KV cache, block table and seq_lens).
+Importing these modules needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL
+helpers.
+"""

+"""The verify attention of one Muse Spark layer as a fragment of the persistent kernels: K3
+and HA run it at their head (attn = "swa" / "full"), so the layer's attention and its decoder
+work are one launch.
+
+Shapes (a TP8 rank): 16 q heads, 2 kv heads (QPK = 8), head dim 64, 8 query tokens a request,
+NR requests (K3 S8: 1, S16: 2; HA S32: 4). K / V bf16 in the layer's vLLM LBHNC cache
+[block][2][16][K 64 | V 64] (block 16); the page table is the layer group's block_table
+(int32 [NR][stride]); seq_used = vLLM's seq_lens (int32 [NR], keys incl. the 8 new ones).
+q [8 NR, 16, 64] bf16 (row stride 1024, without the QK scale); out attn_o [8 NR, 1024] bf16.
+SWA: vLLM's window (2047, 0), keys qpos - key < 2048, and only keys in the window are read
+(vLLM frees the blocks before it: their block-table entries are stale).
+
+Split (every CTA): group = (request, kv head), CPG CTAs a group; CTA j of a group takes tiles
+[lo_t + j tps, +tps) of 64 keys (tps = ceil(n_t / CPG) at run time) for all 64 rows (8 tokens x 8
+heads) of the kv head. 8 waves = 4 row quarters (16 rows) x 2 tile lanes; a step = 2 tiles.
+K / V tiles: global -> VGPR (PD steps ahead; one 64-bit block base a wave, a wave loads the 16
+keys of one block) -> LDS. S^T = K Q^T (16x16x32 bf16 MFMA, a lane holds one q row), online
+softmax (exp2 domain, the -inf -> 0 rule), O^T = V^T P^T (P^T lane-local by a key permutation
+inside the 32-key k block; V^T from LDS with ds_read_b64_tr_b16). The 2 tile lanes merge in LDS;
+the CTA writes (m, l, unnormalized o) for 64 rows (fp32, device scope) + one tagged flag.
+
+Merge: item = (group, row) -> one output row of 64 d. NR = 1: CTA 2i merges item i with 512
+threads (32 segment lanes x 16 d-quads); NR >= 2: NR / 2 items a CTA. Poll the group's flags,
+load the partials, merge (max trick) per thread, over lanes and over waves, out = o / l -> bf16
+-> attn_o and the same rows as tagged pairs (P_AO), which the consumer (K3 stage O, HA ng)
+polls directly.
+
+Descriptor (int64 words, device memory; vllm_desc): 0 q, 1 the KV cache base, 2 its block stride
+in elements (a value), 3 block table, 4 seq_lens, 5 attn_o (out), 6 part (scratch of
+part_bytes()), 7 block-table row stride (elements), 8 real requests (requests >= it are graph
+padding: no split, zero output rows, their flags still set), 9 the softmax scale x log2(e) as
+fp32 bits. A fragment's descriptor is row `layer` of a table of TABLE_ROWS rows.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.kernels_common import LOG2E
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from .dev import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_NT,
+    OOB_BOUND,
+    THREADS,
+    bf16_pair,
+    hw_exp2,
+    ld_i32,
+    ld_i32_if,
+    ld_vec,
+    ld_vec_if,
+    mb_poll,
+    mb_put,
+    mb_put2,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    permlane_swap,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    xred,
+)
+
+HKV, QPK, HD, BS, TILE, NQ = 2, 8, 64, 16, 64, 8
+NH = HKV * QPK
+WIN_SWA = 2048  # vLLM's window (2047, 0) -> keys qpos - key < 2048
+KP = 72  # LDS row stride of a K / V tile (bf16)
+KPW = KP // 2
+NEG = float("-inf")
+PGMAX = 512  # page ids a CTA staged in one round (128 tiles)
+# keys a request the page staging covers (max_position_embeddings)
+VLLM_MAX_KEYS = 1 << 20
+REGION_IDS = {"aseg": 40}
+DESC_WORDS = 10
+TABLE_ROWS = 64
+
+# parts of the scratch buffer (bytes); the segment count is always BLOCKS (G x CPG <= 256)
+P_O = 0  # partial o, fp32 [seg][row][64]
+P_ML = BLOCKS * 64 * HD * 4  # (m, l) [seg][row]
+P_SF = P_ML + BLOCKS * 64 * 2 * 4  # one tagged flag a segment
+P_IF = BLOCKS * 64 * (HD + 4) * 8  # one tagged flag an output row
+P_AO = P_IF + 16 * 128 * 8  # attn_o as tagged pairs [row][512 words]
+P_END = P_AO + 128 * 512 * 8
+assert P_SF + BLOCKS * 8 <= P_IF
+
+
+def part_bytes():
+    return P_END
+
+
+def default_cpg(NR, swa):
+    g = NR * HKV
+    if swa:
+        return min(BLOCKS // g, 17)  # 2 tiles a CTA (34 tiles at most in the window)
+    return BLOCKS // g
+
+
+def make(NR, swa, maxk=VLLM_MAX_KEYS):
+    """The fragment for NR requests; swa = SWA (window 2048) or full attention. It stages enough
+    page ids a CTA for maxk keys a request (PGN)."""
+    # K / V load cache policy: cached for SWA, nontemporal for full
+    KCM = 0 if swa else CM_NT
+
+    G = NR * HKV
+    CPG = default_cpg(NR, swa)
+    # steps a CTA at the window / at 32k context
+    NST = -(-(-(-(34 if swa else 512) // CPG)) // 2)
+    PD = max(1, min(4, NST))  # K / V steps in flight
+    assert G * CPG <= BLOCKS
+    NI = NR * NQ * NH  # output rows
+    if NI >= BLOCKS:
+        IPC = NI // BLOCKS
+        STR = 1
+    else:
+        IPC = 1
+        STR = BLOCKS // NI
+    TPI = THREADS // IPC
+    WPI = TPI // 64
+    SL = TPI // 16
+    SPT = -(-CPG // SL)
+    assert IPC * TPI == THREADS and WPI >= 1 and NI <= 16 * 128 and PGMAX == THREADS
+    WIN = WIN_SWA if swa else 0
+    PGN = PGMAX  # page ids staged a CTA (LDS); full attention: maxk keys a request (PGN // THREADS rounds)
+    if not swa:
+        tiles = -(-(-(-maxk // TILE)) // CPG)  # tiles a CTA at maxk keys
+        PGN = max(PGMAX, -(-tiles * (TILE // BS) // THREADS) * THREADS)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Lds:
+        kv: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * 2 * 64 * KPW, 16]  # [tile lane][K | V][key][KP bf16]
+        # tile lane 1 -> 0: [quarter][lane][m, l, acc 16]
+        mrg: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 4 * 64 * 18, 16]
+        mg2: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 8 * 16 * 6, 16]  # merge: [wave][d quad][M, L, A 4]
+        # the CTA's page ids, staged once (off the K / V vmcnt chain)
+        pg: fx.Array[fx.Int32, PGN, 16]
+
+    def fmax(a, b):
+        return (a > b).select(a, b)
+
+    def fadd(a, b):
+        return a + b
+
+    def p64(dv, i):
+        lo = uniform(dv[2 * i])
+        hi = uniform(dv[2 * i + 1])
+        return (fx.Int64(hi) << fx.Int64(32)) | (fx.Int64(lo) & fx.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF))

+        dv = []

+            q=p64(dv, 0),
+            k=p64(dv, 1),
+            v=p64(dv, 2),
+            pt=p64(dv, 3),
+            used=p64(dv, 4),
+            out=p64(dv, 5),
+            part=p64(dv, 6),
+            pts=uniform(dv[14]),
+            nreq=uniform(dv[16]),
+            qks=uniform(dv[18]).bitcast(fx.Float32),

+            lo = fx.max(ctx - WIN + 1, 0)

+            lo = fx.Int32(0)

+        hi_t = (seq_len + TILE - 1) // TILE
+        n_t = hi_t - lo_t
+        tps = fx.max((n_t + CPG - 1) // CPG, 1)
+        nseg = (n_t + tps - 1) // tps
+        return seq_len, ctx, lo_t, hi_t, tps, nseg

+    def tr16(kvb, byte):
+        ptr = fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.inttoptr(kvb.type, fx.Int64(byte)))
+        return fx.Vector(
+            rocdl.ds_read_tr16_b64(T.vec(4, T.bf16), ptr).result, (4,), fx.BFloat16
+        )
+
+    def kv_load(d, t0, t1, seq_len, kvh, step, pgl, ltl, lkey, lch, wlo=None):
+        tile = t0 + 2 * step + ltl

+        ok = (tile < t1) & (kg < seq_len)
+        pg = fx.ptr_load(
+            pgl + fx.min((2 * step + ltl) * (TILE // BS) + lkey // BS, PGN - 1)
+        )

+            ok = ok & (kg >= wlo)

+            fx.Int64(uniform(pg)) * d.v + fx.Int64(kvh * (BS * 2 * HD))

+    def step(

+        s,
+        kvc,

+        l,

+        t0,
+        t1,
+        seq_len,
+        kvh,
+        pgl,
+        ltl,
+        lkey,
+        lch,
+        wtl,
+        r16,
+        g,
+        qpos,
+        qb,
+        kvl,
+        kvbase,
+        wlo=None,

+        """One step (2 tiles): K / V of step s (kvc) -> LDS, the loads of step s + PD issued, then this wave's tile."""
+        gpu.barrier()
+        for kind in range_constexpr(2):
+            words = [kvc[8 * kind + i] for i in range(8)]
+            b0 = ((ltl * 2 + kind) * 64 + lkey) * KPW + 8 * lch
+            fx.ptr_store(fx.Vector.from_elements(words[:4], fx.Int32), kvl + b0)

+        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)

+        kb = tile * TILE
+        tin = tile < t1
+        # S^T = K Q^T: lane holds q row r16, keys 16 n + 4 g + i
+        xs = []
+        mx = fx.Float32(NEG)
+        for n in range_constexpr(4):
+            sv = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+            for c in range_constexpr(2):
+                a = fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(
+                        kvl
+                        + ((wtl * 2) * 64 + 16 * n + r16) * KPW
+                        + (32 * c + 8 * g) // 2,
+                        result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                    )
+                ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+                sv = mfma_bf16(a, qb[c], sv)
+            for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                key = kb + 16 * n + 4 * g + i
+                ok = tin & (key <= qpos)
+                if const_expr(swa):
+                    ok = ok & ((qpos - key) < WIN)
+                x = ok.select(sv[i] * d.qks, fx.Float32(NEG))
+                xs.append(x)
+                mx = fmax(mx, x)

+        mx = xred(mx, 32, fmax)
+        mj = fmax(m, mx)
+        mj = (mj > fx.Float32(NEG)).select(mj, fx.Float32(0.0))
+        ps = [hw_exp2(x - mj) for x in xs]
+        alpha = hw_exp2(m - mj)
+        psum = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for x in ps:
+            psum = psum + x
+        l = l * alpha + psum
+        acc = [
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([acc[j][i] * alpha for i in range(4)], fx.Float32)
+            for j in range(4)
+        ]
+        m = mj
+        # O^T += V^T P^T
+        for c in range_constexpr(2):
+            pb = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [
+                    bf16_pair(ps[(2 * c) * 4 + 0], ps[(2 * c) * 4 + 1]),
+                    bf16_pair(ps[(2 * c) * 4 + 2], ps[(2 * c) * 4 + 3]),
+                    bf16_pair(ps[(2 * c + 1) * 4 + 0], ps[(2 * c + 1) * 4 + 1]),
+                    bf16_pair(ps[(2 * c + 1) * 4 + 2], ps[(2 * c + 1) * 4 + 3]),
+                ],
+                fx.Int32,
+            ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+            for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                row1 = 32 * c + 4 * g + r16 // 4
+                col = 16 * j + 4 * (r16 % 4)
+                vb = kvbase + (((wtl * 2 + 1) * 64 + row1) * KP + col) * 2
+                lo_ = tr16(kvl, vb)
+                hi_ = tr16(kvl, vb + 16 * KP * 2)
+                a = lo_.shuffle(hi_, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])
+                acc[j] = mfma_bf16(a, pb, acc[j])
+        return m, l, acc, kvn
+
+    @traced
+    def split(d, tag, tid, bid, lane, wave, L):
+        kvl = L.kv.ptr
+        kvbase = fx.Int32(fx.ptrtoint(kvl))
+        grp = bid // CPG
+        jseg = bid % CPG
+        req = grp // HKV
+        kvh = grp % HKV
+        seq_len, ctx, lo_t, hi_t, tps, nseg = geom(d, req)
+        t0 = lo_t + jseg * tps
+        t1 = fx.min(t0 + tps, hi_t)
+        wlo = None
+        if const_expr(swa):
+            wlo = fx.max(ctx - WIN + 1, 0)  # the first key in the window
+        if (bid < G * CPG) & (req < d.nreq):
+            if t0 < t1:
+                nst = (t1 - t0 + 1) // 2
+                # load lanes: tile lane, key, 16 B chunk
+                ltl = tid // 256
+                lkey = (tid % 256) // 4
+                lch = tid % 4
+
+                # this wave: row quarter qr (16 q rows), tile lane wtl
+                qr = wave % 4
+                wtl = wave // 4
+                r16 = lane % 16
+                g = lane // 16
+                m_row = 16 * qr + r16
+                tok = m_row // QPK
+                head = kvh * QPK + m_row % QPK
+                qpos = ctx + tok

+                    ld_vec(
+                        d.q,
+                        ((NQ * req + tok) * (NH * HD) + head * HD + 32 * c + 8 * g)
+                        // 2,
+                        4,
+                    ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+                    for c in range(2)
+                ]
+                pgl = L.pg.ptr
+                # full attention past 128 tiles a CTA
+                for r in range_constexpr(1, PGN // THREADS):
+                    tr = tid + r * THREADS
+                    pk = t0 * (TILE // BS) + tr
+                    pok = (tr < (t1 - t0) * (TILE // BS)) & (pk * BS < seq_len)
+                    fx.ptr_store(
+                        ld_i32_if(pok, d.pt, req * d.pts + pk, OOB_BOUND), pgl + tr
+                    )
+                pk = t0 * (TILE // BS) + tid  # page tid of the CTA's range
+                pok = (tid < (t1 - t0) * (TILE // BS)) & (pk * BS < seq_len)
+                if const_expr(swa):
+                    # blocks before the window: stale ids, not read
+                    pok = pok & ((pk + 1) * BS > wlo)
+                pgv = ld_i32_if(pok, d.pt, req * d.pts + pk, OOB_BOUND)
+                fx.ptr_store(pgv, pgl + fx.min(tid, PGMAX - 1))
+                gpu.barrier()
+                kvq = []
+                # in step order: the scheduler must not move slot 0 behind the others
+                for i in range_constexpr(PD):
+                    kvq.append(
+                        kv_load(d, t0, t1, seq_len, kvh, i, pgl, ltl, lkey, lch, wlo)
+                    )
+                    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+                m = fx.Float32(NEG)
+                l = fx.Float32(0.0)
+                acc = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(4)]
+                s = fx.Int32(0)
+                while s < nst:
+                    # PD steps a trip with fixed register slots (a rotated list makes LLVM copy the slots at the back
+                    # edge behind a vmcnt wait); steps past nst are fully masked (no loads, no change of m / l / acc)
+                    for j in range_constexpr(PD):
+                        m, l, acc, kvn = step(
+                            d,
+                            s + j,
+                            kvq[j],
+                            m,
+                            l,
+                            acc,
+                            t0,
+                            t1,
+                            seq_len,
+                            kvh,
+                            pgl,
+                            ltl,
+                            lkey,
+                            lch,
+                            wtl,
+                            r16,
+                            g,
+                            qpos,
+                            qb,
+                            kvl,
+                            kvbase,
+                            wlo,
+                        )
+                        kvq = kvq[:j] + [kvn] + kvq[j + 1 :]
+                    s = s + PD
+                lt = xred(l, 16, fadd)
+                lt = xred(lt, 32, fadd)
+                mrg = L.mrg.ptr
+                mb = (qr * 64 + lane) * 18
+                if wtl == 1:
+                    fx.ptr_store(m, mrg + mb)
+                    fx.ptr_store(lt, mrg + mb + 1)
+                    for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                        for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                            fx.ptr_store(acc[j][i], mrg + mb + 2 + 4 * j + i)
+                gpu.barrier()
+                if wtl == 0:
+                    m1 = fx.ptr_load(mrg + mb)
+                    l1 = fx.ptr_load(mrg + mb + 1)
+                    mm = fmax(m, m1)
+                    a0 = hw_exp2(m - mm)
+                    a1 = hw_exp2(m1 - mm)
+                    lf = lt * a0 + l1 * a1
+                    seg = grp * CPG + jseg
+                    po = d.part + fx.Int64(P_O)
+                    for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                        ov = [
+                            acc[j][i] * a0 + fx.ptr_load(mrg + mb + 2 + 4 * j + i) * a1
+                            for i in range(4)
+                        ]
+                        bo.buffer_store(
+                            fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                                [v_.bitcast(fx.Int32) for v_ in ov], fx.Int32
+                            ),
+                            rsrc(po),
+                            ((seg * 64 + m_row) * HD + 16 * j + 4 * g),
+                            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,

+                    if g == 0:
+                        bo.buffer_store(
+                            fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                                [mm.bitcast(fx.Int32), lf.bitcast(fx.Int32)], fx.Int32
+                            ),
+                            rsrc(d.part + fx.Int64(P_ML)),
+                            (seg * 64 + m_row) * 2,
+                            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                        )
+                rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0, expcnt=0, lgkmcnt=0)
+                gpu.barrier()
+                if tid == 0:
+                    mb_put(tag, d.part + fx.Int64(P_SF), grp * CPG + jseg, fx.Int32(1))
+
+    def comb(Ma, La, Aa, Mb, Lb, Ab):
+        M = fmax(Ma, Mb)
+        wa = (Ma > fx.Float32(NEG)).select(hw_exp2(Ma - M), fx.Float32(0.0))
+        wb = (Mb > fx.Float32(NEG)).select(hw_exp2(Mb - M), fx.Float32(0.0))

+
+    @traced
+    def merge(d, tag, health, tid, bid, lane, wave, L):
+        if const_expr(STR > 1):
+            has = (bid % STR) == 0
+            item = bid // STR
+        else:
+            has = bid >= 0
+            item = bid * IPC + tid // TPI
+        if has:
+            itl = tid // TPI
+            tt = tid % TPI

+DIAG_WORDS = 8
+TIMEOUT_TICKS = 2 * 100_000_000  # 2 s at 100 MHz

+def bf_tile_load_mma(wbase, row16, ldk, k, lane, cm=CM_NT):
+    """16 rows (row16 ..) x 128 K (k ..) of a row-major bf16 [*, ldk] weight, loaded straight in the
+    16x16x32 bf16 MFMA A-operand layout: element qq (of 4) is the operand of MFMA step qq (lane l = row
+    l % 16, K 32 qq + 8 (l / 16) .. + 8), 16 rows x 64 B an instruction. The same operand values as
+    bf_tile_load + bf_mma_operand (bit-identical results) without the 8 ds_bpermute a step."""
+    rowm = row16 + lane % 16
+    kk = k + 8 * (lane // 16)
+    return [ld_vec(wbase, (rowm * ldk + kk + 32 * qq) // 2, 4, cm) for qq in range(4)]
+
+
+def bf_mma_operand(ops, qq, lane):
+    """Coalesced bf16 weight registers (4 instructions: rows 8 blk + lane / 8, 16 B at
+    128 h + 16 (lane % 8)) -> the MFMA A operand of step qq (K 32 qq + 8 g of row r)."""
+    r = lane % 16
+    g = lane // 16
+    h = qq // 2
+    src = 8 * (r % 8) + 4 * (qq % 2) + g
+    hi = r >= 8
+    ws = []
+    for jj in range_constexpr(4):
+        pa = bpermute(ops[h][jj], src)
+        pb = bpermute(ops[2 + h][jj], src)
+        ws.append(hi.select(pb, pa))
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(ws, fx.Int32)

+def bf_tile_load(wbase, row16, ldk, k, lane):
+    """16 rows (row16 ..) x 128 K (k ..) of a row-major bf16 [*, ldk] weight, coalesced."""
+    out = []
+    for blk in range_constexpr(2):
+        rowc = row16 + 8 * blk + lane // 8
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            out.append(
+                ld_vec(wbase, (rowc * ldk + k + 64 * h + 8 * (lane % 8)) // 2, 4, CM_NT)
+            )
+    return out

+def fp4_mma(ops, base, bl, brow, lane, acc, c, jpar, rows, row0=0):
+    """Chunk c (256 K) of a 16-row MXFP4 group: 8 MFMA steps, B column n = LDS row row0 + n (at
+    most rows - 1: columns past the expert's picks read some row, their outputs are never stored).
+    ``jpar``: the task's 16-row group parity (j & 1), for the shuffled scales."""
+    g = lane // 16
+    t = fx.min(row0 + lane % 16, rows - 1)

+def task_ring(load, compute, q, task, it, end, unr, *args):
+    """Tasks task .. end - 1: compute(q[0], task, it, *args) with the next len(q) tasks' loads
+    (load(task)) in flight. ``unr`` (len(q) = 2): three tasks an iteration in fixed slots (q[0],
+    q[1], qc): two tasks' loads stay in flight during each compute, no rotation copy waits for its
+    data (the tail: the second loop)."""
+    if const_expr(unr):
+        while task + 2 < end:
+            qc = load(task + 2)
+            compute(q[0], task, it, *args)
+            qa = load(task + 3)
+            compute(q[1], task + 1, it + 1, *args)
+            qb = load(task + 4)
+            compute(qc, task + 2, it + 2, *args)
+            q = [qa, qb]
+            task = task + 3
+            it = it + 3
+    while task < end:
+        nxt = load(task + len(q))
+        compute(q[0], task, it, *args)
+        q = q[1:] + [nxt]
+        task = task + 1
+        it = it + 1
+    return q, task, it

+    """Every rank's peer buffer (IPC-shared), [parity] first."""
+    assert world == W, world
+    return _lay(
+        [
+            ("logit", 2 * KQ * S * E * 8),  # [par][kq][t][e] tagged
+            ("hraw", 2 * S * DM * 2),  # [par][t][col] bf16 plain
+            ("hf", 2 * W * BLOCKS * 8),  # [par][src][CTA] tagged flags
+            ("moep", 2 * W * S * (DM // 2) * 8),  # [par][src][t][pair] tagged
+            ("y", 2 * S * (HID // 2) * 8),  # [par][t][pair] tagged
+            # o_proj partials [par][src][t][pair] tagged
+            ("op", 2 * W * S * (HID // 2) * 8),
+            # the owner's reduced o_proj [par][t][pair] tagged (all-gather)
+            ("orr", 2 * S * (HID // 2) * 8),
+            # the owner's reduced EP sum [par][t][pair] tagged (all-gather)
+            ("mrr", 2 * S * (DM // 2) * 8),
+            # the AB owners' norm partials [par][t][CTA][4] tagged (all-gather)
+            ("ssa4p", 2 * 4 * S * BLOCKS * 8),
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+_BUILDS = {}
+
+
+def build(key: Build):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    # FlyDSL keys its disk cache on sources + *scalar* closure values; the Build
+    # dataclass is not a scalar, so every knob read as key.x would share one binary.
+    # Referencing this string from the launcher puts the whole key into the cache key.
+    _KEYSTR = repr(key)
+    S = key.S
+    assert S in (8, 16), S
+    XQROW = XQ + XPAD
+    CA = XQ // KCH // WAVES  # stage-A pre-proj chunks a wave
+    CO = OK_K // KCH // WAVES  # o_proj chunks a wave
+    QPF = 4  # qkvg tiles issued before stage G (of NQT)
+    P = S * TOPK
+    RROUNDS = (S + WAVES - 1) // WAVES
+    lay, _ = scratch_layout(S)
+    play, _ = peer_layout(S)
+    PF_GU = 2 if S == 8 else 1  # gate_up tasks in flight
+    PF_DN = 2  # down tasks in flight
+    # gate_up: the two 16-row halves of a task in separate MFMA passes
+    GUSPLIT = S == 16
+    W13_BYTES = EL * 2 * INTER * (DM // 2)
+    W13S_BYTES = EL * 2 * INTER * (DM // 32)
+    # stage A: a KQ-CTA group (K parts) covers RT pre-proj rows and EG router experts
+    RS_PRE = DM // W
+    RT = RS_PRE // NG  # 512 / 32 = 16
+    NT_A = RT // 16  # MFMA tiles a CTA
+    OWN = RT // KQ  # rows a CTA owns after the K-part exchange
+    EG = (E // W) // NG  # router experts a group
+    TPE = THREADS // EG  # threads an expert
+    KPT = XQ // TPE  # router K a thread
+    assert (NT_A, OWN, EG, KPT) == (1, 2, 1, 2), (NT_A, OWN, EG, KPT)
+    # stage F: post_expert_proj rows RS_POST a rank, 16-row tiles
+    RS_POST = HID // W
+    NTL = RS_POST // 16
+    TPC = 1  # tiles a CTA
+    KSP = BLOCKS // NTL  # K split of a tile
+    assert KSP == 4, KSP
+    KR = DM // KSP  # K a CTA reads
+    CPW = KR // KCH // WAVES  # chunks a wave a tile
+    MROW = KR + XPAD
+    tag_par = lambda tag: tag & 1
+

+    YROW = OK_K + XPAD

+    FA = None

+    UNR = S == 8  # gate_up / down task loops as a ring (unroll 3, fixed slots)

+    CPRX = BLOCKS // W  # CTA blocks a rank owns (owner of block b = b // CPRX)

+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ stage A (sharded)
+    @traced
+    def stage_a(
+        x,
+        w_r,
+        bias,
+        w_pre,
+        scratch,
+        peer,
+        pl,
+        tag,
+        health,
+        tid,
+        bid,
+        lane,
+        wave,
+        rank,
+        xl,
+        red,
+        own,
+        tok,
+    ):
+        """CTA b = (group rb = b / KQ, K part kq = b % KQ): router experts EG rb .. and
+        pre-proj rows RT rb .. of this rank's shard over K part kq."""
+        tid = fresh(tid)  # no cross-stage CSE of tid-derived offsets (S=16 spills)
+        lane = fresh(lane)
+        g = lane // 16
+        kq = bid % KQ
+        rb = bid // KQ
+        k0 = kq * XQ
+        par = tag_par(tag)
+        nx = S * XQ // 8
+        # weights first (data independent), then the ffn_in quarter's 64 flags, then x
+        ei = tid // TPE
+        kr = (tid % TPE) * KPT
+        wr = ld_vec(w_r, (EG * rb + ei) * HID + k0 + kr, 2)  # KPT = 2 router weights
+        bias_v = [ld_f32(bias, lane + 64 * i) for i in range(4)]
+        wp = []
+        for nt in range_constexpr(NT_A):
+            for ci in range_constexpr(CA):
+                c = wave + WAVES * ci
+                wp.append(
+                    bf_tile_load(w_pre, rb * RT + nt * 16, HID, k0 + c * KCH, lane)
+                )
+        if tid < BLOCKS // KQ:  # the CTAs owning this K part's columns (32 a CTA)
+            mb_poll(
+                tag,
+                health,
+                [(scratch + fx.Int64(lay["xf"][0]), kq * (BLOCKS // KQ) + tid, 1)],
+                REGION_IDS["xf"],
+            )
+        gpu.barrier()
+        xv = []
+        for i in range_constexpr((nx + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+            e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, nx - 1)
+            t = e // (XQ // 8)
+            kk = (e % (XQ // 8)) * 8
+            xv.append(
+                ld_vec(
+                    scratch + fx.Int64(lay["xin"][0]),
+                    (t * HID + k0 + kk) // 2,
+                    4,
+                    CM_DEV,
+                )
+            )
+        for i in range_constexpr((nx + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+            e = tid + THREADS * i
+            if e < nx:
+                t = e // (XQ // 8)
+                kk = (e % (XQ // 8)) * 8
+                fx.ptr_store(xv[i], xl + (t * XQROW + kk) // 2)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        wf = [wr[0].bitcast(fx.Float32), wr[1].bitcast(fx.Float32)]
+        for t in range_constexpr(S):
+            pr = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            xw1 = fx.ptr_load(xl + (t * XQROW + kr) // 2)
+            pr = pr + bf_lo(xw1) * wf[0]
+            pr = pr + bf_hi(xw1) * wf[1]
+            pr = wave_sum(pr)
+            if lane == 0:
+                fx.ptr_store(pr, tok + (wave * S + t))
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if tid < EG * S:
+            e2 = tid // S
+            t = tid % S
+            v = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for w in range_constexpr(WAVES // EG):
+                v = v + fx.ptr_load(tok + ((e2 * (WAVES // EG) + w) * S + t))
+            eg = rank * (E // W) + EG * rb + e2
+            idx = ((par * KQ + kq) * S + t) * E + eg
+            for pb in pl:
+                mb_put_sys(tag, pb + fx.Int64(play["logit"][0]), idx, v)
+        accs = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(NT_A)]
+        t = fx.min(lane % 16, S - 1)
+        for nt in range_constexpr(NT_A):
+            for ci in range_constexpr(CA):
+                c = wave + WAVES * ci
+                for qq in range_constexpr(4):
+                    kk = c * KCH + 8 * g + 32 * qq
+                    b = fx.Vector(
+                        fx.ptr_load(
+                            xl + (t * XQROW + kk) // 2,
+                            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                        )
+                    ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+                    accs[nt] = mfma_bf16(
+                        bf_mma_operand(wp[nt * CA + ci], qq, lane).bitcast(fx.BFloat16),
+                        b,
+                        accs[nt],
+                    )
+        for nt in range_constexpr(NT_A):
+            fx.ptr_store(accs[nt], red + ((wave * NT_A + nt) * 64 + lane) * 4)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        # thread (row pair rp, token tt) over the group's RT rows: this quarter's partial
+        if tid < (RT // 2) * S:
+            rp = tid // S
+            tt = tid % S
+            v = []
+            for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                rr = 2 * rp + h2
+                s_ = fx.Float32(0.0)
+                for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+                    s_ = s_ + fx.ptr_load(
+                        red
+                        + (
+                            ((w * NT_A + rr // 16) * 64 + 16 * ((rr % 16) // 4) + tt)
+                            * 4
+                            + rr % 4
+                        )
+                    )
+                v.append(s_)
+            owner = (2 * rp) // OWN
+            if owner == kq:
+                fx.ptr_store(v[0], own + ((2 * rp - kq * OWN) * S + tt))
+                fx.ptr_store(v[1], own + ((2 * rp + 1 - kq * OWN) * S + tt))
+            else:
+                for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                    mb_put(
+                        tag,
+                        scratch + fx.Int64(lay["px"][0]),
+                        ((rb * KQ + kq) * 64 + 2 * rp + h2) * S + tt,
+                        v[h2],
+                    )
+        gpu.barrier()
+        # own rows: the KQ parts in order -> bf16 h_raw -> every rank's HRAW
+        if tid < (OWN // 2) * S:
+            rp = tid // S
+            tt = tid % S
+            specs, oks = [], []
+            for src in range_constexpr(KQ):
+                for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                    specs.append(
+                        (
+                            scratch + fx.Int64(lay["px"][0]),
+                            ((rb * KQ + src) * 64 + kq * OWN + 2 * rp + h2) * S + tt,
+                            1,
+                        )
+                    )
+                    oks.append(fx.Int32(src) != kq)
+            got = mb_poll(tag, health, specs, REGION_IDS["px"], oks=oks)
+            tot = []
+            for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                s_ = fx.Float32(0.0)
+                for src in range_constexpr(KQ):
+                    mine = fx.ptr_load(own + ((2 * rp + h2) * S + tt))
+                    s_ = s_ + (fx.Int32(src) == kq).select(
+                        mine, got[2 * src + h2][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+                    )
+                tot.append(s_)
+            col = (rank * RS_PRE) + rb * RT + kq * OWN + 2 * rp
+            hw = bf16_pair(tot[0], tot[1])
+            idx = (par * S * DM + tt * DM + col) // 2
+            for pb in pl:
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    hw, rsrc(pb + fx.Int64(play["hraw"][0])), idx, cache_modifier=CM_SYS
+                )
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0, expcnt=0, lgkmcnt=0)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if tid == 0:
+            fidx = (par * W + rank) * BLOCKS + bid
+            for pb in pl:
+                mb_put_sys(tag, pb + fx.Int64(play["hf"][0]), fidx, fx.Int32(1))
+        return bias_v
+
+    @traced
+    def route_poll(peer, tag, health, lane, wave):
+        """This wave's tokens' 256 logits from the local peer buffer: KQ K-part partials
+        each, summed in part order (identical on every CTA of every rank)."""
+        par = tag_par(tag)
+        specs = [
+            (
+                peer + fx.Int64(play["logit"][0]),
+                ((par * KQ + kq) * S + fx.min(wave + WAVES * rr, S - 1)) * E
+                + lane
+                + 64 * i,
+                1,
+            )
+            for rr in range(RROUNDS)
+            for i in range(4)
+            for kq in range(KQ)
+        ]
+        got = mb_poll(
+            tag,
+            health,
+            specs,
+            REGION_IDS["logit"],
+            batch=min(len(specs), 32),
+            cm=CM_SYS,
+        )  # W = 8 (KQ = 8): 2 polls of 32
+        out = []
+        for rr in range_constexpr(RROUNDS):
+            lgs = []
+            for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                base = (rr * 4 + i) * KQ
+                v = got[base][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+                for kq in range_constexpr(1, KQ):
+                    v = v + got[base + kq][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+                lgs.append(v.bitcast(fx.Int32))
+            out.append(lgs)
+        return out

+    @traced
+    def h_wait_issue(peer, w_pren, tag, health, tid, rank):
+        """Every producing rank's HRAW flags, then this thread's h_raw (cols kk .. kk+8
+        of every token) from the local peer buffer and its w_pre values."""
+        par = tag_par(tag)
+        NSRC = W
+        nf = NSRC * BLOCKS
+        specs, oks = [], []
+        for i in range_constexpr((nf + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+            f = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, nf - 1)
+            src = f // BLOCKS
+            specs.append(
+                (
+                    peer + fx.Int64(play["hf"][0]),
+                    (par * W + src) * BLOCKS + f % BLOCKS,
+                    1,
+                )
+            )
+            oks.append((tid + THREADS * i) < nf)
+        mb_poll(tag, health, specs, REGION_IDS["hf"], oks=oks, cm=CM_SYS)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        kk = (tid % (DM // 8)) * 8
+        wv = ld_vec(w_pren, kk // 2, 4)
+        hv = []
+        for t in range_constexpr(S):
+            hv.append(
+                ld_vec(
+                    peer + fx.Int64(play["hraw"][0]),
+                    (par * S * DM + t * DM + kk) // 2,
+                    4,
+                    CM_SYS,
+                )
+            )
+        return hv, wv

+    @traced
+    def stage_route(scratch, bias_v, lgs_r, tag, health, rank, tid, lane, wave, rt):
+        """Every token's routing (wave w: tokens w, w + 8, ...), then the local union."""
+        if const_expr(S <= WAVES):
+            if wave < S:
+                route_token([wave], bias_v, [lgs_r[0]], tid, lane, rt)
+        else:
+            # S a multiple of 8: wave w routes tokens w, w + 8, .. interleaved
+            route_token(
+                [wave + WAVES * rr for rr in range(RROUNDS)],
+                bias_v,
+                lgs_r,
+                tid,
+                lane,
+                rt,
+            )
+        gpu.barrier()
+        # the union U of local experts (sorted), kof[u][t]; picks list
+        e0 = rank * EL
+        # parallel: picks flag their experts, a scan numbers U, picks scatter kof
+        for ii in range_constexpr((EL * S + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+            ix = tid + THREADS * ii
+            if ix < EL * S:
+                fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(-1), rt["kof"] + ix)
+        if tid < EL:
+            fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(0), rt["sel"] + tid)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        for ii in range_constexpr((P + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+            pq = tid + THREADS * ii
+            if pq < P:
+                eid = slot_of(fx.ptr_load(rt["rid"] + pq), e0)
+                if eid >= 0:
+                    fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(1), rt["sel"] + eid)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if wave == 0:
+            ucarry = fx.Int32(0)
+            for hh in range_constexpr((EL + 63) // 64):
+                el_ = lane + 64 * hh
+                f = fx.ptr_load(rt["sel"] + fx.min(el_, EL - 1))
+                f = (el_ < EL).select(f, fx.Int32(0))
+                incl = wave_incl_scan(f, lane) + ucarry
+                slot = incl - f
+                if f != 0:
+                    fx.ptr_store(el_, rt["uexp"] + slot)
+                if el_ < EL:
+                    fx.ptr_store(slot, rt["uslot"] + el_)
+                ucarry = readlane(incl, 63)
+            if lane == 63:
+                fx.ptr_store(ucarry, rt["nu"] + 0)
+        if wave == 1:
+            # local picks p = t*8 + k in (t, k) order (lane p, then p + 64, ...)
+            carry = fx.Int32(0)
+            for hh in range_constexpr((P + 63) // 64):
+                pl_ = lane + 64 * hh
+                pp = fx.min(pl_, P - 1)
+                eid = slot_of(fx.ptr_load(rt["rid"] + pp), e0)
+                loc = ((eid >= 0) & (pl_ < P)).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+                incl = wave_incl_scan(loc, lane) + carry
+                if loc != 0:
+                    fx.ptr_store(pl_, rt["plist"] + (incl - loc))
+                if pl_ < P:
+                    fx.ptr_store(incl - loc, rt["pidx"] + pp)
+                carry = readlane(incl, 63)
+            if lane == 63:
+                fx.ptr_store(carry, rt["np_"] + 0)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        for ii in range_constexpr((P + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+            pq = tid + THREADS * ii
+            if pq < P:
+                eid = slot_of(fx.ptr_load(rt["rid"] + pq), e0)
+                if eid >= 0:
+                    slot = fx.ptr_load(rt["uslot"] + eid)
+                    fx.ptr_store(
+                        fx.Int32(pq % TOPK), rt["kof"] + (slot * S + pq // TOPK)
+                    )
+        gpu.barrier()
+
+    def slot_of(e, e0):
+        """Local slot of global expert e on this rank (-1: not computed here)."""
+        el_ = e - e0
+        return ((el_ >= 0) & (el_ < EL)).select(el_, fx.Int32(-1))
+
+    def gu_loads(w13, w13s, rt, task, lane, wave, ok):
+        """Task (u, j)'s w13 operands for this wave: gate / up row groups x the
+        wave's 2 chunks of 256 K: 2 dwordx4 + 1 scale dword each. ``ok`` false:
+        zeros, no memory access (a lookahead past the CTA's last task)."""
+        r = lane % 16
+        g = lane // 16
+        task = ok.select(task, fx.Int32(0))
+        u = task >> 8
+        j = task & 255
+        e = uniform(fx.ptr_load(rt["uexp"] + u))
+        ops = []
+        if const_expr(GUSPLIT):
+            # waves 0-3 the gate rows, 4-7 the up rows; wave w the chunks 4 (w % 4) + i
+            rgs = [wave // 4]
+            cs = [4 * (wave % 4) + i for i in range(4)]
+        else:
+            rgs = list(range(2))
+            cs = [2 * wave + i for i in range(2)]
+        for rg in rgs:
+            rbase = e * (2 * INTER) + rg * INTER + j * 16
+            for c in cs:
+                ops += mx_chunk(
+                    ok, w13, w13s, rbase, DM, c, lane, g, r, W13_BYTES, W13S_BYTES
+                )
+        return ops
+
+    @traced
+    def load_h_norm(hv, wv, tid, lane, wave, hl, tok):
+        """Rstd per token from the full h_raw, h = bf16(h_raw rstd w) -> LDS."""
+        kk = (tid % (DM // 8)) * 8
+        for t in range_constexpr(S):
+            ss = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for d in range_constexpr(4):

+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ stage QKV: next layer's qkv+gate
+    # Head-aligned tile map: group gq < NH = HQ + 2 HKV holds the 4 tiles of head gq (q heads, then k,
+    # then v) + gate tile NQKVT + gq; groups NH .. hold the other gate tiles (5 a group, the tail padded).
+    # After the K-split partial sums, CTA k8 of the group owns the tokens t = k8 (mod 8) for all its rows,
+    # so it holds whole heads and finishes them (qk-norm, RoPE, q / KV stores). The qkv rows also go to
+    # the scratch region. The x eighth is the MFMA B operand straight from registers; the weights load in
+    # the MFMA A-operand layout (bf_tile_load_mma).
+    NH = HQ + 2 * HKV
+    NQKVT = QKV_ROWS // 16
+    assert NQT == 5 and NH <= 32 and S % 8 == 0, (NQT, NH, S)
+
+    def q8_tile(gq, n):
+        """Tile index (traced) of chunk-tile n of group gq (the head-aligned map)."""
+        head = gq < NH
+        if const_expr(n < 4):
+            return head.select(4 * gq + n, NQKVT + NH + NQT * (gq - NH) + n)
+        return head.select(NQKVT + gq, NQKVT + NH + NQT * (gq - NH) + n)
+
+    def q8_loads(w_qkvg, bid, lane, wave, n0, n1):
+        k8 = bid % 8
+        gq = bid // 8
+        out = []
+        for n in range_constexpr(n0, n1):
+            tl = q8_tile(gq, n)
+            row16 = fx.min(tl, NQTILES - 1) * 16
+            out.append(
+                bf_tile_load_mma(w_qkvg, row16, HID, k8 * XQ8 + wave * KCH, lane)
+            )
+        return out

+    @traced
+    def vllm_finish(w2, hh, tt, p, q_out, k_cache, v_cache, slots, cos_sin, pos):
+        """The owner's head finish: head hh (uniform), token tt (uniform in the wave), lane p = pair
+        (2p, 2p + 1) of the head; w2 = the bf16 pair of the qkv GEMV.
+        q / k as vLLM's fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert: weightless qk-norm, then GPT-J RoPE in
+        fp32 with the fp32 cos / sin, one RNE bf16 rounding (bf16_pair); q without qk_scale. V passes
+        through (the bf16 GEMV). K / V pairs go as one bf16 dword into the LBHNC cache, element
+        ((slot >> 4) * bstride + (kv * 16 + (slot & 15)) * 128 + 64 isv + 2p), bstride = v_cache (the
+        block stride in elements, a value, not a pointer); slot < 0 (padded rows) skipped. The block
+        base is 64-bit and wave-uniform (one buffer resource a wave)."""
+        x0 = bf_lo(w2)
+        x1 = bf_hi(w2)
+        ss = butterfly(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1, (1, 2, 4, 8, 16))
+        rs = hw_rsq(ss * fx.Float32(1.0 / HD) + fx.Float32(PRE_EPS))
+        isv = hh >= HQ + HKV
+        isq = hh < HQ
+        n0 = x0 * rs
+        n1 = x1 * rs
+        if const_expr(key.next_rope):
+            ps = ld_i32(pos, tt * 2)  # int64 positions: low word
+            c = ld_f32(cos_sin, ps * HD + p)
+            sn = ld_f32(cos_sin, ps * HD + HD // 2 + p)
+            r0 = n0 * c - n1 * sn
+            r1 = n0 * sn + n1 * c
+            n0 = r0
+            n1 = r1
+        o0 = isv.select(x0, n0)
+        o1 = isv.select(x1, n1)
+        row0 = (hh * HD) // 2 + p
+        if isq:
+            bo.buffer_store(bf16_pair(o0, o1), rsrc(q_out), (tt * QROWS) // 2 + row0)
+        else:
+            kv = hh - HQ - isv.select(fx.Int32(HKV), fx.Int32(0))
+            # int64 slot_mapping: low word (-1 = padding)
+            slot = uniform(ld_i32(slots, tt * 2))
+            if slot >= 0:
+                eoff = fx.Int64(slot >> 4) * v_cache + fx.Int64(
+                    (kv * 16 + (slot & 15)) * 128
+                    + isv.select(fx.Int32(HD), fx.Int32(0))
+                )
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    bf16_pair(o0, o1), rsrc(k_cache + eoff * fx.Int64(2)), p
+                )

+    @traced

+"""HA and HB: one Muse Spark decoder layer for S = 32 / 64 / 96 / 128 rows as two persistent
+launches around HM (k5m.py, the local experts); one rank of a TP = EP = 8 group.
+
+    [attention] -> HA -> HM -> HB
+
+HA  optional: this layer's verify attention (attn_frag.py) at the head; o-norm x gate
+    (distributed) -> o_proj (rows 32 b .., K = this rank's 1024) -> the bf16 partials go to
+    the owner rank -> attention boundary (post_attn_norm, gated residual, pre-FFN norm) ->
+    ffn_in -> router (fp32, 32 experts a rank) and pre_expert_proj (512 rows a rank), K in 8
+    parts over 8-CTA groups -> logits and h_raw all-gathered -> top-8 (CTA t routes token t)
+    -> h = pre_expert_norm(h_raw) (CTA t: token t) -> h, top-k ids / weights for HM.
+HB  EP all-reduce of HM's partial (reduce-scatter to the column-block owner + all-gather) ->
+    post_expert_proj (this rank's 1024 rows, K in 4 parts) -> post-FFN norm, gated residual,
+    next input norm -> xn -> qkv + gate (K eighths) -> head finishers (qk-norm, RoPE,
+    q out, bf16 K / V into vLLM's LBHNC KV cache).
+
+The boundaries (Build.bnd). S > 32, token owners: rank r owns tokens t = r (mod 8); the o_proj
+partials and the post_expert_proj outputs go to the owner rank of each token, one CTA a token
+does the whole row (all-reduce sum, both norms, gated residual) and the ffn_in / xn rows are
+all-gathered. The residual stream lives token-sharded (rank r: its S / 8 rows, fp32, all 8192
+columns); HA reads it as rows so the first layer can read a full replicated stream (s_full);
+HB writes it the same way and (``gather``) all-gathers it. S = 32, column blocks: the o_proj
+partials go to the owner of the column block, which reduces and all-gathers them; both
+boundaries run on all 256 CTAs (token groups x column groups, one-hop token norms) and the
+stream is replicated.
+
+Every row tile is 16 tokens (MFMA N); dense stages keep their weights in VGPRs and loop over
+the S / 16 row tiles with the activations read straight from L2 / peer memory in MFMA
+layout. Tags: tag = epoch * 64 + layer + 1 (HA and HB of a layer share it, regions are
+disjoint); peer regions double buffered by tag parity.

+        groups, the stream replicated); 0 (S > 32): the token-owner boundaries (one CTA a
+        token, the stream token-sharded and all-gathered by HB)."""
+        return 3 if self.S == 32 else 0
+
+
+def scratch_layout(S, world=W, bnd=0):
+    assert world == W, world
+    TS = S // W
+    extra = (
+        []
+        if not bnd
+        else [
+            # the mid stream, replicated [t][col] fp32 (each CTA its 32 columns)
+            ("smidb", S * HID * 4),
+            ("xinb", S * HID * 2),
+            ("xinbf", BLOCKS * 8),  # ffn_in [t][col] bf16 + a flag a CTA
+            ("xnb", S * HID * 2),
+            ("xnbf", BLOCKS * 8),  # the next layer's input [t][col] bf16 + a flag a CTA
+            ("ssa4", (4 * S * BLOCKS + 2 * S) * 8),
+            ("ssg4", (4 * S * BLOCKS + 2 * S) * 8),  # partials, rstd
+            ("gpa", BLOCKS * 16 * 8),
+            # [CTA][4 tokens][4] partials of the AB / G
+            ("gpg", BLOCKS * 16 * 8),
+        ]
+    )
+    return _lay(
+        [
+            ("y", S * OK_K * 2),
+            ("yf", BLOCKS * 8),
+            ("smid", TS * HID * 4),
+            ("px", EL * KQ * 16 * S * 8),
+            ("m", S * DM * 2),
+            ("mmf", BLOCKS * 8),
+            # [K part - 1][tile][row][t]
+            ("py", max(128, (KSP - 1) * NTILES) * 16 * S * 8),
+            ("qx", 32 * 8 * NQT * 16 * S * 8),
+            ("qkv", S * (QKV_ROWS // 2) * 8),
+        ]
+        + extra
+    )
+
+
+def peer_layout(S, world=W, bnd=0):
+    assert world == W, world
+    TS = S // W
+    extra = (
+        []
+        if not bnd
+        else [
+            # o_proj partials to the block owner [par][src][t][own blk][pair]
+            ("opb", 2 * W * S * (BLOCKS // W) * 16 * 8),
+            # the owner's reduced o, all-gathered [par][t][pair] tagged
+            ("orb", 2 * S * (HID // 2) * 8),
+            # stage F's y, all-gathered [par][t][pair] tagged
+            ("yb", 2 * S * (HID // 2) * 8),
+        ]
+    )
+    # the bnd regions go last: HM (k5m) addresses moep / mf with the layout of the plain build
+    return _lay(
+        [
+            ("op", 2 * W * TS * (HID // 2) * 4),
+            ("opf", 2 * W * BLOCKS * 8),
+            ("xin", 2 * S * (HID // 2) * 4),
+            ("xf", 2 * S * 8),
+            ("logit", 2 * KQ * S * E * 8),
+            ("hraw", 2 * S * (DM // 2) * 4),
+            ("hf", 2 * W * BLOCKS * 8),
+            ("moep", 2 * W * S * (DM // 2) * 4),
+            ("mf", 2 * W * BLOCKS * 8),
+            ("moem", 2 * S * (DM // 2) * 4),
+            ("mmf", 2 * BLOCKS * 8),
+            ("yt", 2 * TS * (HID // 2) * 4),
+            ("ytf", 2 * W * NTILES * 8),
+            ("xn", 2 * S * (HID // 2) * 4),
+            ("xnf", 2 * S * 8),
+            ("sg", 2 * S * HID * 4),
+            ("sgf", 2 * S * 8),
+        ]
+        + extra
+    )
+
+
+_BUILDS = {}
+
+
+def build(key: Build):
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    _KEYSTR = repr(key)  # FlyDSL disk-cache key (see k3.build)
+    S = key.S
+    assert S in (32, 64, 96, 128), S
+    NT = S // 16
+    TS = S // W  # tokens a rank owns in the token-owner boundaries
+    CO = OK_K // KCH // WAVES  # o_proj chunks a wave
+    CA = QH // KCH // WAVES  # stage-A pre-proj chunks a wave
+    CP = (DM // KSP) // KCH // WAVES  # post-proj chunks a wave
+    KPT = QH // THREADS  # router K a thread
+    NFQ = W * BLOCKS // THREADS  # producer flags a thread (opf / hf polls)
+    QPF = 3  # qkvg tiles issued before stage G (of NQT)
+    CPR = BLOCKS // W  # CTAs (16-column blocks) a rank owns in the EP reduce-scatter
+    assert TS * W == S and NFQ * THREADS == W * BLOCKS and W * NTILES * 8 >= 512
+    BND = key.bnd != 0  # the column-block boundaries (S = 32)
+    QR1 = S == 32  # QKV5 reduces both 16-token row tiles in one LDS round
+    lay, _ = scratch_layout(S, W, key.bnd)
+    play, _ = peer_layout(S, W, key.bnd)
+    tag_par = lambda tag: tag & 1
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class RouteLds:
+        rid: fx.Array[fx.Int32, TOPK, 16]
+        rw: fx.Array[fx.Float32, TOPK, 16]
+        sel: fx.Array[fx.Int32, TOPK * 3 + 8, 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class HaO:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, NT * WAVES * 2 * 64 * 4, 16]
+
+    XAROW = QH + 8  # LDS row of the x slice tile (bf16)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class HaA:
+        x: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 16 * XAROW // 2, 16]
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+        tok: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 16 + 8 + S, 16]
+        own: fx.Array[fx.Float32, NT * OWN * 16, 16]
+
+    FA = None
+    if key.attn:  # the fused attention fragment (attn_frag.py)
+        from . import attn_frag
+
+        assert key.attn in ("swa", "full"), key
+        FA = attn_frag.make(S // 8, key.attn == "swa")
+        FaLds = FA.Lds
+        # the fragment's source hash: the disk cache does not follow FA.run
+        _KEYSTR = _KEYSTR + FA.key
+
+    @fx.union
+    class HaLds:
+        o_: HaO
+        a_: HaA
+        if FA is not None:
+            fa_: FaLds
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class HbF:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, NT * WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class HbQ:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, (NT if QR1 else 1) * WAVES * NQT * 64 * 4, 16]
+        own: fx.Array[fx.Float32, NT * NQT * 2 * 16, 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class HbLds:
+        f_: HbF
+        q_: HbQ
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Misc:
+        pad: fx.Array[fx.Int64, TL_POINTS, 16]  # unused: keeps the tuned LDS offsets
+        # bnd: tok_rstd2 uses rs[2S .. 2S + 32)
+        rs: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 2 * S + (32 if BND else 8), 16]
+        # bnd: the polled group partials + wave sums
+        pr: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 512 + 64 if BND else 8, 16]
+        red4: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 32, 16]
+
+    name_a = f"muse_k5a_s{S}" + (f"_fa{key.attn}" if key.attn else "")
+    name_b = f"muse_k5b_s{S}_r{int(key.next_rope)}"
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ shared helpers
+    def red_at(red, base_tile, rr, tt):
+        """LDS offset of row rr (0..15), token tt (0..15) of MFMA tile slot base_tile."""
+        return red + ((base_tile * 64 + 16 * (rr // 4) + tt) * 4 + rr % 4)
+
+    @traced
+    def block_sum(v, lane, wave, red4, slot):
+        """Sum of v over the CTA's 512 threads (fixed order: lanes, then waves)."""
+        v = wave_sum(v)
+        if lane == 0:
+            fx.ptr_store(v, red4 + (slot * 8 + wave))
+        gpu.barrier()
+        tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+            tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red4 + (slot * 8 + w))
+        return tot
+
+    # ============================================================ HA
+    def o_loads(w_o, bid, lane, wave):
+        ops = []
+        for i in range_constexpr(2):
+            for ci in range_constexpr(CO):
+                c = wave + WAVES * ci
+                ops.append(bf_tile_load(w_o, bid * 32 + 16 * i, OK_K, c * KCH, lane))
+        return ops
+
+    @traced
+    def stage_ng(attn_o, attn_g, g_stride, scratch, tag, tid, bid, nrows, ao=None):
+        """Y = bf16(o rms(o) sigmoid(g)) per 64-wide head, distributed: 8 lanes a (token, head)."""
+        tid = fresh(tid)
+        gt = bid * THREADS + tid
+        item = gt // 8
+        if item < S * HQ:
+            t = item // HQ
+            kk = (item % HQ) * HD + (gt % 8) * 8
+            # padded rows (t >= nrows) repeat the last real row
+            tl_ = fx.min(t, nrows - 1)
+            if const_expr(ao is None):
+                xv = ld_vec(attn_o, (tl_ * OK_K + kk) // 2, 4)
+            else:  # the fused attention: the merged rows as tagged pairs
+                got = mb_poll(
+                    tag,
+                    ao[1],
+                    [
+                        (ao[0], (tl_ * OK_K + kk) // 2, 2),
+                        (ao[0], (tl_ * OK_K + kk) // 2 + 2, 2),
+                    ],
+                    43,
+                )
+                xv = got[0] + got[1]
+            gv = ld_vec(attn_g, (tl_ * g_stride + kk) // 2, 4)
+            ow = o_gate(xv, gv)
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(ow, fx.Int32),
+                rsrc(scratch + fx.Int64(lay["y"][0])),
+                (t * OK_K + kk) // 2,
+                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+            )
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0, expcnt=0, lgkmcnt=0)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if (tid == 0) & (bid < S * HQ * 8 // THREADS):
+            mb_put(tag, scratch + fx.Int64(lay["yf"][0]), bid, fx.Int32(1))
+
+    @traced
+    def stage_o(o_ops, scratch, pl, tag, health, tid, bid, lane, wave, rank, red):
+        """o_proj rows 32b .. (this rank's K slice) for all S tokens; the bf16 partial goes to
+        the owner rank of the column block (bnd: b // CPR) or of each token (t % W)."""
+        tid = fresh(tid)
+        lane = fresh(lane)
+        par = tag_par(tag)
+        g = lane // 16
+        t = lane % 16
+        if tid < S * HQ * 8 // THREADS:
+            mb_poll(
+                tag,
+                health,
+                [(scratch + fx.Int64(lay["yf"][0]), tid, 1)],
+                REGION_IDS["yf"],
+            )
+        gpu.barrier()
+        ybase = scratch + fx.Int64(lay["y"][0])
+        # MFMA A operands once (reused by every row tile)
+        oa = [
+            [
+                bf_mma_operand(o_ops[i * CO + ci], qq, lane).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+                for qq in range(4)
+            ]
+            for i in range(2)
+            for ci in range(CO)
+        ]
+
+        def ob_loads(rt):
+            return [
+                ld_vec(
+                    ybase,
+                    ((16 * rt + t) * OK_K + (wave + WAVES * ci) * KCH + 8 * g + 32 * qq)
+                    // 2,
+                    4,
+                    YCM,
+                ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+                for ci in range(CO)
+                for qq in range(4)
+            ]
+
+        # row groups of 2 tiles (32 tokens): MFMA -> barrier -> (next group's loads) -> reduce + push,
+        # so the XGMI pushes of a group overlap the next group's loads and MFMAs
+        NG = NT // 2
+        nxt = ob_loads(0) + ob_loads(1)
+        for gi in range_constexpr(NG):
+            cur = nxt
+            for r2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                rt = 2 * gi + r2
+                accs = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(2)]
+                for ci in range_constexpr(CO):
+                    for i in range_constexpr(2):
+                        for qq in range_constexpr(4):
+                            accs[i] = mfma_bf16(
+                                oa[i * CO + ci][qq],
+                                cur[r2 * (4 * CO) + ci * 4 + qq],
+                                accs[i],
+                            )
+                for i in range_constexpr(2):
+                    fx.ptr_store(
+                        accs[i], red + (((rt * WAVES + wave) * 2 + i) * 64 + lane) * 4
+                    )
+            gpu.barrier()
+            if const_expr(gi + 1 < NG):
+                nxt = ob_loads(2 * gi + 2) + ob_loads(2 * gi + 3)
+            if const_expr(BND):
+                # the CTA's whole [32 columns x tokens] tile to the owner of block b (b // 32), tagged pairs
+                e = tid
+                pp = e % 16
+                tt32 = e // 16
+                rt_ = 2 * gi + tt32 // 16
+                t16 = tt32 % 16
+                v = []
+                for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                    rr = 2 * pp + h2
+                    s_ = fx.Float32(0.0)
+                    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+                        s_ = s_ + fx.ptr_load(
+                            red_at(red, (rt_ * WAVES + w) * 2 + rr // 16, rr % 16, t16)
+                        )
+                    v.append(s_)
+                pdo = sel_peer(pl, uniform(bid // CPR))
+                mb_put_sys(
+                    tag,
+                    pdo + fx.Int64(play["opb"][0]),
+                    ((par * W + rank) * S + 16 * rt_ + t16) * (CPR * 16)
+                    + (bid % CPR) * 16
+                    + pp,
+                    bf16_pair(v[0], v[1]),
+                )
+            else:
+                e = tid
+                # owner t % 8: wave w pushes owner w's 2 tokens of both tiles of the group
+                rt_ = 2 * gi + (e // 32) % 2
+                pp = e % 16
+                dw = uniform(wave)
+                tt = dw + W * ((e // 16) % 2)
+                v = []
+                for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                    rr = 2 * pp + h2
+                    s_ = fx.Float32(0.0)
+                    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+                        s_ = s_ + fx.ptr_load(
+                            red_at(red, (rt_ * WAVES + w) * 2 + rr // 16, rr % 16, tt)
+                        )
+                    v.append(s_)
+                t_ = 16 * rt_ + tt
+                # one destination a wave (SGPR peer select): no branch around the store (a branch makes
+                # the waitcnt pass drain everything), and the links carry every group in parallel
+                idx = (((par * W + rank) * BLOCKS + bid) * TS + t_ // W) * 16 + pp
+                w2 = bf16_pair(v[0], v[1])
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    w2,
+                    rsrc(sel_peer(pl, dw) + fx.Int64(play["op"][0])),
+                    idx,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        if const_expr(not BND):  # bnd: tagged pairs, no flags
+            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0, expcnt=0, lgkmcnt=0)
+            gpu.barrier()
+            if tid == 0:
+                for pb in pl:
+                    mb_put_sys(
+                        tag,
+                        pb + fx.Int64(play["opf"][0]),
+                        (par * W + rank) * BLOCKS + bid,
+                        fx.Int32(1),
+                    )
+
+    @traced
+    def stage_ab(
+        own_peer,
+        pl,
+        scratch,
+        stream_in,
+        s_full,
+        nrows,
+        alpha_a,
+        beta_a,
+        w_pffn,
+        tag,
+        health,
+        tid,
+        bid,
+        lane,
+        wave,
+        rank,
+        red4,
+    ):
+        """CTA j < S / W: token t = W j + rank, all 8192 columns (16 a thread): the W o_proj
+        partials (rank order) -> o, post_attn_norm (weightless, 1e-8), gated residual (mid stream,
+        local), pre_feedforward_layernorm -> the ffn_in row pushed to every rank + flag."""
+        tid = fresh(tid)
+        par = tag_par(tag)
+        j = bid
+        t = W * j + rank
+        # replicated [rows, 8192] or token-sharded
+        srow = (s_full != 0).select(fx.min(t, nrows - 1), j)
+        st, al, be, wfs = [], [], [], []
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            cq = 8 * (tid + THREADS * h)
+            wfs.append(ld_vec(w_pffn, cq // 2, 4))
+            for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                v4 = ld_vec(stream_in, srow * HID + cq + 4 * h2, 4)
+                a4 = ld_vec(alpha_a, cq + 4 * h2, 4)
+                b4 = ld_vec(beta_a, cq + 4 * h2, 4)
+                for d in range_constexpr(4):
+                    st.append(v4[d].bitcast(fx.Float32))
+                    al.append(a4[d].bitcast(fx.Float32))
+                    be.append(b4[d].bitcast(fx.Float32))
+        specs = [
+            (own_peer + fx.Int64(play["opf"][0]), par * W * BLOCKS + NFQ * tid + q, 1)
+            for q in range(NFQ)
+        ]
+        mb_poll(tag, health, specs, REGION_IDS["opf"], cm=CM_SYS)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        a = [fx.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(16)]
+        for src in range_constexpr(W):
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):
+                # 8-column chunk: columns 8q .. 8q + 8 (block q / 4)
+                q = tid + THREADS * h
+                wv = ld_vec(
+                    own_peer + fx.Int64(play["op"][0]),
+                    (((par * W + src) * BLOCKS + q // 4) * TS + j) * 16 + 4 * (q % 4),
+                    4,
+                    XCM,
+                )
+                for d in range_constexpr(4):
+                    k = 8 * h + 2 * d
+                    if const_expr(src == 0):
+                        a[k] = bf_lo(wv[d])
+                        a[k + 1] = bf_hi(wv[d])
+                    else:
+                        a[k] = a[k] + bf_lo(wv[d])
+                        a[k + 1] = a[k + 1] + bf_hi(wv[d])
+        o = [bf16_round(x) for x in a]
+        ss = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for k in range_constexpr(16):
+            ss = ss + o[k] * o[k]
+        r1 = hw_rsq(
+            block_sum(ss, lane, wave, red4, 0) * fx.Float32(1.0 / HID)
+            + fx.Float32(POST_EPS)
+        )
+        sv = [al[k] * st[k] + be[k] * bf16_round(o[k] * r1) for k in range(16)]
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            cq = 8 * (tid + THREADS * h)
+            for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                        [sv[8 * h + 4 * h2 + d].bitcast(fx.Int32) for d in range(4)],
+                        fx.Int32,
+                    ),
+                    rsrc(scratch + fx.Int64(lay["smid"][0])),
+                    j * HID + cq + 4 * h2,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                )
+        ss2 = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for k in range_constexpr(16):
+            ss2 = ss2 + sv[k] * sv[k]
+        r2 = hw_rsq(
+            block_sum(ss2, lane, wave, red4, 1) * fx.Float32(1.0 / HID)
+            + fx.Float32(PRE_EPS)
+        )
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            cq = 8 * (tid + THREADS * h)
+            wf = wfs[h]
+            xw = [
+                bf16_pair(
+                    (sv[8 * h + 2 * d] * r2) * bf_lo(wf[d]),
+                    (sv[8 * h + 2 * d + 1] * r2) * bf_hi(wf[d]),
+                )
+                for d in range(4)
+            ]
+            xv = fx.Vector.from_elements(xw, fx.Int32)
+            for pb in pl:
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    xv,
+                    rsrc(pb + fx.Int64(play["xin"][0])),
+                    (par * S + t) * (HID // 2) + cq // 2,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0, expcnt=0, lgkmcnt=0)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if tid == 0:
+            for pb in pl:
+                mb_put_sys(tag, pb + fx.Int64(play["xf"][0]), par * S + t, fx.Int32(1))
+
+    def a_loads(w_r, w_pre, bid, tid, lane, wave):
+        """CTA b = (group rb = b / KQ, K part kq = b % KQ): router expert rb of this rank (fp32,
+        KPT K a thread) and pre_expert_proj rows 16 rb .. (CA chunk tiles a wave)."""
+        kq = bid % KQ
+        rb = bid // KQ
+        wr = ld_vec(w_r, rb * HID + kq * QH + KPT * tid, KPT)
+        wp = []
+        for ci in range_constexpr(CA):
+            c = wave + WAVES * ci
+            wp.append(bf_tile_load(w_pre, rb * 16, HID, kq * QH + c * KCH, lane))
+        return wr, wp
+
+    @traced
+    def stage_a(

+        tag,
+        health,

+        bid,
+        lane,

+        NXQ = 16 * QV // THREADS  # of them a thread

+        def ax_loads(rt):

+                ld_vec(

+        tid = fresh(tid)
+        par = tag_par(tag)

+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ bnd: column-group boundaries
+    # CTA b = token group tg = b / 32 (tokens 4 tg .. 4 tg + 4) x column group cb = b % 32 (columns 256 cb .. + 256);
+    # thread = (token tq = tid / 128, column pair pp = tid % 128). The token norms reduce in the CTA (2 waves a
+    # token), then over the 32 CTAs of the token group in ONE hop: every CTA of the group reads the group's 32 x 4 x 4
+    # partials (fixed order cb = 0 .. 31) instead of a reducer CTA and a second hop.
+    @traced
+    def group_rstd2(
+        scratch,
+        region,
+        tag,
+        health,
+        tid,
+        lane,
+        wave,
+        bid,
+        q1,
+        q2,
+        q3,
+        q4,
+        eps1,
+        eps2,
+        pr,
+    ):
+        """-> (r1, r2) of this thread's token from the 4 norm partials of every CTA of the token group."""
+        tg = bid // 32
+        base = scratch + fx.Int64(lay[region][0])
+        qs = [wave_sum(q) for q in (q1, q2, q3, q4)]
+        if lane == 0:
+            for k in range_constexpr(4):
+                fx.ptr_store(qs[k], pr + (512 + wave * 4 + k))
+        gpu.barrier()
+        # token tq = tid / 4, partial k = tid % 4: the token's 2 waves in order
+        if tid < 16:
+            v = fx.ptr_load(pr + (512 + (2 * (tid // 4)) * 4 + tid % 4)) + fx.ptr_load(
+                pr + (512 + (2 * (tid // 4) + 1) * 4 + tid % 4)
+            )
+            mb_put(tag, base, bid * 16 + tid, v)
+        src = tid // 16  # (column group, token, partial) of the group, one a thread
+        got = mb_poll(
+            tag,
+            health,
+            [(base, (tg * 32 + src) * 16 + tid % 16, 1)],
+            REGION_IDS[region],
+        )
+        fx.ptr_store(got[0][0].bitcast(fx.Float32), pr + tid)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if tid < 4:  # token tid: the 32 groups in order, then the two norms
+            p = []
+            for k in range_constexpr(4):
+                a_ = fx.ptr_load(pr + (tid * 4 + k))
+                for c_ in range_constexpr(1, 32):
+                    a_ = a_ + fx.ptr_load(pr + (c_ * 16 + tid * 4 + k))
+                p.append(a_)
+            r1 = hw_rsq(p[0] * fx.Float32(1.0 / HID) + fx.Float32(eps1))
+            q = p[1] + fx.Float32(2.0) * r1 * p[2] + r1 * r1 * p[3]
+            r2 = hw_rsq(q * fx.Float32(1.0 / HID) + fx.Float32(eps2))
+            fx.ptr_store(r1, pr + (512 + 32 + tid))
+            fx.ptr_store(r2, pr + (512 + 36 + tid))
+        gpu.barrier()
+        tq = tid // 128
+        return fx.ptr_load(pr + (512 + 32 + tq)), fx.ptr_load(pr + (512 + 36 + tq))
+
+    @traced

+"""HM: this rank's routed experts for S = 32 / 64 / 96 / 128 rows as one persistent launch
+between HA and HB (k5.py); one rank of a TP = EP = 8 group.
+
+Inputs from HA: h [S, 4096] bf16 (pre_expert_norm output), top-8 ids [S, 8] and weights [S, 8].
+Every CTA builds the same tables: the picks of each local expert in token order, split into
+virtual experts of at most 16 picks (one MFMA N tile). Tasks: (virtual expert v, row tile j),
+256 a virtual expert (gate_up: 16 gate + 16 up rows; down: 16 output rows); CTA b owns tasks
+[b V, (b+1) V) (V virtual experts), so it spans at most two virtual experts and keeps their
+picks' h (gate_up) / a (down) rows in LDS. Weights MXFP4 (w13 / w2 + E8M0 scales) in vLLM's
+shuffled layouts, streamed with a prefetch queue, decoded in registers
+(v_cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp4), bf16 MFMA.
+
+  gate_up: a = bf16(silu(bf16 g) bf16 u) -> scratch A (tagged pairs, pick rows)
+  down:    z = bf16(w_post bf16(y)) -> scratch Z (tagged), per-pick sums of squares a CTA
+  rstd:    CTA c: the post-expert-norm rstd of picks c, c + 256, .. (tagged)
+  final:   CTA b, columns 16b ..: part[t] = sum over t's local picks (k order) of
+           bf16(z rstd) w -> pushed to the owner rank of the column block (b / 32) = HB's
+           reduce-scatter input (+ flags), and part_out (a local copy).
+Same tag as HA / HB of the layer (epoch * 64 + layer + 1).

+"""Device buffers that every rank of a group maps through IPC handles."""
+
+import ctypes
+
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch.distributed import ProcessGroup
+
+from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.cuda_wrapper import (
+    CudaRTLibrary,
+    cudaIpcMemHandle_t,
+)
+
+
+class PeerBuffer:
+    """One zeroed ``cudaMalloc`` buffer a rank, mapped by every rank of a group.
+
+    The monokernel polls these mailboxes with system-scope loads, so they come
+    from a plain device allocation: not torch's caching allocator (pool
+    offsets) and not the uncached custom all-reduce buffers. Freed by
+    ``close()`` or when the object is collected (like ``CustomAllreduce``).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, nbytes: int, group: ProcessGroup) -> None:
+        self.nbytes = nbytes
+        self.pointers: list[int] = []
+        self._opened: list[ctypes.c_void_p] = []
+        self.local: ctypes.c_void_p | None = None
+        self.lib = CudaRTLibrary()
+        self.rank = dist.get_rank(group=group)
+        self.local = self.lib.cudaMalloc(nbytes)
+        self.lib.cudaMemset(self.local, 0, nbytes)
+        self.lib.cudaDeviceSynchronize()
+        handle = self.lib.cudaIpcGetMemHandle(self.local)
+
+        handles: list[bytes | None] = [None] * dist.get_world_size(group=group)
+        dist.all_gather_object(handles, bytes(handle), group=group)
+
+        for rank, raw in enumerate(handles):
+            if rank == self.rank:
+                pointer = self.local
+            else:
+                assert raw is not None
+                pointer = self.lib.cudaIpcOpenMemHandle(
+                    cudaIpcMemHandle_t.from_buffer_copy(raw)
+                )
+                self._opened.append(pointer)
+            assert pointer.value is not None
+            self.pointers.append(pointer.value)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Unmap the peers' buffers and free this rank's; idempotent."""
+        while self._opened:
+            self.lib.cudaIpcCloseMemHandle(self._opened.pop())
+        if self.local is not None:
+            self.lib.cudaFree(self.local)
+            self.local = None
+        self.pointers = []
+
+    def __del__(self) -> None:
+        self.close()

inline_comments.body: deployment_refusals does not refuse sleep mode or weight transfer. The attach keeps bf16 copies of five norm multipliers per layer (:199-204) plus the epoch and health words in tensors that are neither parameters nor buffers, allocated in the cumem weights pool. With the recipe's --monokernel command plus --enable-sleep-mode, the documented sleep(level=2), wake_up, reload_weights flow restores only named buffers, and ROCm wakes the rest of the pool zeroed (vllm/device_allocator/cumem.py:361-363). Reload never calls the model-level process_weights_after_loading, so refresh_weights (mono/init.py:96-98) never runs. Verify steps of 1-16 requests then run layers 1-60 with zero norm multipliers and emit wrong tokens. Weight-transfer refits skip the refresh the same way. Refuse enable_sleep_mode and weight_transfer_config, as vllm/models/minimax_m3/amd/specialized_decode/runtime/spec.py:63-66 does.

+  vLLM's attention op on that q is layer i+1's attention.
+- layer 61: vLLM's attention op, then the stock tail.

inline_comments.body: Thanks: the attach-time copies (the bf16 norm multipliers, the epoch and health words) are neither parameters nor buffers, so a sleep / wake-up / reload cycle does not restore them, and neither a reload nor a weight-transfer refit calls the model-level `process_weights_after_loading`. Fixed in e00fcfa: `deployment_refusals` now refuses `enable_sleep_mode` ("sleep mode on") and `weight_transfer_config` ("weight transfer on"), as the MiniMax M3 specialized decode does. The deployment guard test checks both reasons, and the module README lists them.
